=== FILE: code/balance_guard.py | sha256=254ec99b4da7b344a19bd96a2394cd2c92baf9a73307d0118e2615b2f4d87be4 | bytes=2593 ===
"""Bad balance read guard (bugfix1012, 2026-10-12, owner): fail closed.

A coin that was worth > DUST_USD in the last trusted snapshot (deposit_watch.balances)
and now reads missing or 0 is re-read once. If it is still 0 the check/job ends as an
error with no trades. Only after ACCEPT_AFTER consecutive runs that all read 0 is the
zero accepted (a real full sell-out), recorded in balance-guard.json.
"""
import json, os, time

COINS = ("SOL", "USDC", "cbBTC", "WETH")
DUST_USD = 0.50
ACCEPT_AFTER = 3          # consecutive runs reading 0 before a zero is believed
STREAK_GAP_SEC = 30 * 60  # runs further apart than this do not count as consecutive


class BadBalanceRead(RuntimeError):
    def __init__(self, coins):
        super().__init__("bad_balance_read " + ",".join(coins))
        self.coins = coins


def suspicious(prev, now, prices, dust_usd=DUST_USD):
    out = []
    for s in COINS:
        p = float((prev or {}).get(s) or 0)
        px = 1.0 if s == "USDC" else float((prices or {}).get(s) or 0)
        if p <= 0 or (px > 0 and p * px < dust_usd):
            continue
        v = (now or {}).get(s)
        if v is None or float(v) <= 0:
            out.append(s)
    return out


def _load(path):
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except Exception:
        return {}


def _save(path, st):
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(st, f)
    os.replace(tmp, path)


def guarded_read(read_fn, prev, prices, state_path, log=print, now=time.time, sleep=time.sleep, retry_wait=2.0):
    """read_fn() -> balances dict (or (bals, extra) tuple). Returns read_fn's result or raises BadBalanceRead."""
    res = read_fn()
    bals = res[0] if isinstance(res, tuple) else res
    bad = suspicious(prev, bals, prices)
    if bad:
        log(f"BALANCE_GUARD zero read {bad}; retrying once")
        sleep(retry_wait)
        res = read_fn()
        bals = res[0] if isinstance(res, tuple) else res
        bad = suspicious(prev, bals, prices)
    st = _load(state_path)
    if not bad:
        if st:
            _save(state_path, {})
        return res
    t = now()
    streak = st.get("streak", 0) if (st.get("coins") == bad and t - float(st.get("t") or 0) <= STREAK_GAP_SEC) else 0
    streak += 1
    _save(state_path, {"coins": bad, "streak": streak, "t": t})
    if streak >= ACCEPT_AFTER:
        log(f"BALANCE_GUARD_ACCEPT {bad} read 0 on {streak} consecutive runs; treating as real")
        _save(state_path, {})
        return res
    raise BadBalanceRead(bad)

"""status1012: wallet balance status for the dashboard (desk.json `c` b/T/u/f + bt), independent of log_diet.

Written by the minute check from values it already has (no extra RPC/price calls), at most once per
reporting.json balance_status_every_sec (default 90; 0 = off). Checks run every 60 s, so with 90 s the status
lands on every other check (~120 s apart). Never writes sol-usdc-log.md or the trades files.
"""
import json, os
from datetime import datetime

import degen_home as _DH

PATH = os.path.join(_DH.HOME_STR, "live-balance.json")
REPORTING = os.path.join(_DH.HOME_STR, "reporting.json")
SYMS = ("SOL", "USDC", "cbBTC", "WETH")
JITTER_S = 2.0


def every_sec(path=REPORTING):
    try:
        d = json.load(open(path, encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return 90.0
    v = d.get("balance_status_every_sec")
    if v is None and d.get("balance_status_every_min") is not None:
        v = float(d["balance_status_every_min"]) * 60
    return float(90 if v is None else v)


def snapshot(result, now_iso):
    fills = result.get("fills") or []
    prices = result.get("prices_usd") or {}
    if fills and isinstance(fills[-1], dict) and fills[-1].get("balances_after"):
        bals = fills[-1]["balances_after"]
        total = fills[-1].get("total_usd_after")
        usd = {s: float(bals.get(s) or 0) * float(prices.get(s) or 0) for s in SYMS}
    else:
        bals = result.get("balances") or {}
        usd = result.get("balances_usd") or {}
        total = result.get("total_usd")
    if not bals or total is None:
        return None
    return {"t": now_iso, "b": {s: [bals.get(s), round(float(usd.get(s) or 0), 2)] for s in SYMS},
            "T": round(float(total), 2), "u": result.get("unrealized_pnl_pct"), "f": result.get("funded_usd")}


def maybe_write(result, now_iso, path=PATH, reporting=REPORTING):
    """Returns True when written."""
    ev = every_sec(reporting)
    if ev <= 0:
        return False
    try:
        prev = json.load(open(path, encoding="utf-8"))
        age = (datetime.fromisoformat(now_iso) - datetime.fromisoformat(prev["t"])).total_seconds()
    except Exception:
        age = None
    if age is not None and 0 <= age < ev - JITTER_S and not (result.get("fills") if isinstance(result, dict) else None):  # a fill always refreshes
        return False
    snap = snapshot(result, now_iso)
    if not snap:
        return False
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(snap, f, separators=(",", ":"))
    os.replace(tmp, path)
    return True

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Silent, non-blocking, idempotent boot/shell revive for the trading runner.
# Safe if the folder is missing. Never prints secrets. Does not run a trade check.
# Intended for shell profile / profile.d sourcing (backgrounded by the caller).
#
# Respects a deliberate stop: "runner_ctl.sh stop" writes runner.stopped and
# this hook then does nothing until "runner_ctl.sh start" clears it. A runner
# that was never deliberately stopped is revived on boot/login as before.
set -u

ROOT="${DEGEN_HOME:-$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)}"
CTL="$ROOT/box/runner_ctl.sh"
STOP_MARKER="$ROOT/runner.stopped"

# Fast no-op if tree or ctl missing (e.g. mid-hydrate)
# Mirror guard: a MIRROR_ONLY file means this copy must never trade (Phase 2 = PC is live).
if [[ -e "$ROOT/MIRROR_ONLY" ]]; then
  exit 0
fi
if [[ ! -x "$CTL" ]]; then
  exit 0
fi

# Deliberately stopped: do not revive.
if [[ -e "$STOP_MARKER" ]]; then
  exit 0
fi

# Avoid re-entry storms within the same shell session
if [[ -n "${DEGEN_RUNNER_AUTOSTART_DONE:-}" ]]; then
  exit 0
fi
export DEGEN_RUNNER_AUTOSTART_DONE=1

# "autostart" is idempotent (adopts a live runner, never duplicates) and
# re-checks the stop marker under the ctl lock. Detach so profiles never block.
(
  export PATH="${PATH:-/usr/bin:/bin}:/usr/local/bin"
  mkdir -p "$ROOT/runner-logs" 2>/dev/null || true
  "$CTL" autostart >>"$ROOT/runner-logs/runner-ctl.log" 2>&1 || true
  # Dashboard static server (localhost:8765); idempotent
  if [[ -x "$ROOT/dashboard_serve.sh" ]]; then
    "$ROOT/dashboard_serve.sh" start >>"$ROOT/runner-logs/dashboard-server.log" 2>&1 || true
  fi
  # Cloudflare tunnel DISABLED 2026-10-08: box egress blocks :7844; the site is
  # now served by the Worker `degen-dashboard` (dashboard_publish.py after each check).
  # dashboard_tunnel.sh is kept on disk; re-enable here only if :7844 egress returns.
) >/dev/null 2>&1 &
disown 2>/dev/null || true
exit 0

=== FILE: code/box/runner_ctl.sh | sha256=9d90b24eadf7af0508beffdd27dd6cb3e0454327c55207fed0ce6eec23ad2dbb | bytes=11396 ===
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Start/stop/status for the box-local wallet edge-check runner.
# Usage: ./runner_ctl.sh start|stop|status|autostart|install-reboot
# Does not post webhooks. Does not run a one-shot live check.
#
# Race-safe (2026-10-05):
#  - All commands serialize on runner-ctl.lock (flock).
#  - A live runner is any process whose argv is "<python> $RUNNER" (pidfile pid
#    first, else a /proc scan). start adopts it instead of starting a duplicate.
#  - runner.pid is written only after the new process is confirmed alive.
#  - A failed start never deletes a pidfile that points at a live runner.
#  - status detects a live runner with a missing/stale pidfile and repairs it.
#  - stop writes runner.stopped (stop marker) first, then stops every runner
#    process for this folder. The profile autostart hook calls "autostart",
#    which does nothing while the marker exists. "start" clears the marker.
#    A never-stopped runner is still revived on boot/login by the hook.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="${DEGEN_HOME:-$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)}"
RUNNER="$ROOT/box_runner.py"
PIDFILE="$ROOT/runner.pid"
STOP_MARKER="$ROOT/runner.stopped"
CTL_LOCK="$ROOT/runner-ctl.lock"
LOGDIR="$ROOT/runner-logs"
CTLLOG="$LOGDIR/runner-ctl.log"
PYTHON="$ROOT/.venv/bin/python"
START_CONFIRM_SEC="${START_CONFIRM_SEC:-2}"
STOP_GRACE_SEC="${STOP_GRACE_SEC:-10}"

mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"

ts() { date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'; }

log() {
  printf '%s %s\n' "$(ts)" "$*" >>"$CTLLOG"
}

# Serialize ctl commands. fd 9 is closed for the runner child (9>&-).
take_lock() {
  local wait="${1:-30}"
  exec 9>>"$CTL_LOCK"
  if ! flock -w "$wait" 9; then
    echo "runner_ctl busy (lock wait ${wait}s timed out)" >&2
    return 1
  fi
}

# True when pid is alive and its argv is exactly "<python...> $RUNNER [args]".
is_runner_pid() {
  local pid="${1:-}"
  [[ "$pid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || return 1
  kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || return 1
  [[ -r "/proc/$pid/cmdline" ]] || return 1
  local -a argv=()
  mapfile -d '' -t argv <"/proc/$pid/cmdline" 2>/dev/null || return 1
  (( ${#argv[@]} >= 2 )) || return 1
  [[ "$(basename -- "${argv[0]}")" == python* ]] || return 1
  [[ "${argv[1]}" == "$RUNNER" ]] || return 1
  return 0
}

# All live runner pids for this folder (one per line, ascending).
find_runner_pids() {
  local p
  for p in $(pgrep -f -- "$RUNNER" 2>/dev/null || true); do
    if is_runner_pid "$p"; then
      echo "$p"
    fi
  done
}

# The runner that holds runner.lock, if its pid is recorded there.
lock_holder_pid() {
  local line pid
  line="$(head -n1 "$ROOT/runner.lock" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  pid="${line#pid=}"
  pid="${pid%% *}"
  if is_runner_pid "$pid"; then echo "$pid"; fi
}

# Echo the live runner pid (pidfile first, then lock holder, then scan).
live_runner_pid() {
  local pid=""
  if [[ -f "$PIDFILE" ]]; then
    pid="$(tr -dc '0-9' <"$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if is_runner_pid "$pid"; then echo "$pid"; return 0; fi
  fi
  pid="$(lock_holder_pid)"
  if [[ -n "$pid" ]]; then echo "$pid"; return 0; fi
  pid="$(find_runner_pids | head -n1)"
  if [[ -n "$pid" ]]; then echo "$pid"; return 0; fi
  return 1
}

write_pidfile() {
  local tmp="$PIDFILE.tmp.$$"
  echo "$1" >"$tmp"
  mv -f "$tmp" "$PIDFILE"
}

# Remove the pidfile only when it does not point at a live runner.
clear_stale_pidfile() {
  if [[ -f "$PIDFILE" ]]; then
    local pid
    pid="$(tr -dc '0-9' <"$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if ! is_runner_pid "$pid"; then
      rm -f "$PIDFILE"
    fi
  fi
}

print_heartbeat() {
  if [[ -f "$ROOT/runner-heartbeat.json" ]]; then
    DEGEN_HOME="$ROOT" "$PYTHON" - <<'PY' || true
import json
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(__import__("os").environ.get("DEGEN_HOME", ".")) / "runner-heartbeat.json"
try:
    d = json.loads(p.read_text())
except Exception as e:
    print("heartbeat: unreadable", type(e).__name__)
else:
    for k in ("last_start", "last_end", "last_result", "next_at_pt", "updated_pt", "consecutive_fails"):
        if k in d:
            print(f"  {k}={d[k]}")
PY
  fi
}

cmd_status() {
  # Repair needs the lock; if busy, report read-only.
  local locked=1
  take_lock 5 2>/dev/null || locked=0
  local pid
  if pid="$(live_runner_pid)"; then
    local cur=""
    [[ -f "$PIDFILE" ]] && cur="$(tr -dc '0-9' <"$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ "$cur" != "$pid" ]] && (( locked )); then
      write_pidfile "$pid"
      log "status repaired pidfile (was '${cur:-missing}') -> $pid"
      echo "running pid=$pid (pidfile repaired; was ${cur:-missing})"
    else
      echo "running pid=$pid"
    fi
    local n
    n="$(find_runner_pids | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
    if (( n > 1 )); then
      echo "  WARNING: $n runner processes: $(find_runner_pids | tr '\n' ' ')"
    fi
    print_heartbeat
    return 0
  fi
  (( locked )) && clear_stale_pidfile
  if [[ -f "$STOP_MARKER" ]]; then
    echo "stopped (deliberate stop; autostart suppressed: $(head -n1 "$STOP_MARKER" 2>/dev/null))"
  else
    echo "stopped"
  fi
  return 0
}

# Start (or adopt). $1 = "manual" clears the stop marker; "auto" respects it.
do_start() {
  local mode="$1"
  take_lock 30
  if [[ "$mode" == "auto" && -f "$STOP_MARKER" ]]; then
    echo "autostart skipped: deliberately stopped ($STOP_MARKER present)"
    return 0
  fi
  if [[ "$mode" == "manual" && -f "$STOP_MARKER" ]]; then
    rm -f "$STOP_MARKER"
    log "stop marker cleared by start"
  fi
  local pid
  if pid="$(live_runner_pid)"; then
    local cur=""
    [[ -f "$PIDFILE" ]] && cur="$(tr -dc '0-9' <"$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ "$cur" != "$pid" ]]; then
      write_pidfile "$pid"
      log "start ($mode): adopted live runner pid=$pid (pidfile was '${cur:-missing}')"
    elif [[ "$mode" == "manual" ]]; then
      log "start (manual): already running pid=$pid"
    fi
    echo "already running pid=$pid"
    return 0
  fi
  if [[ ! -x "$PYTHON" ]]; then
    echo "missing venv python: $PYTHON" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  if [[ ! -f "$RUNNER" ]]; then
    echo "missing runner: $RUNNER" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  log "start requested ($mode)"
  # Detached session; the ctl lock fd is not inherited.
  setsid nohup "$PYTHON" "$RUNNER" >>"$LOGDIR/runner-daemon.log" 2>&1 9>&- </dev/null &
  local launched=$!
  sleep "$START_CONFIRM_SEC"
  local newpid=""
  if is_runner_pid "$launched"; then
    newpid="$launched"
  else
    newpid="$(live_runner_pid || true)"
  fi
  if [[ -n "$newpid" ]]; then
    write_pidfile "$newpid"
    log "started pid=$newpid ($mode)"
    echo "started pid=$newpid"
    return 0
  fi
  log "start failed launched=$launched ($mode)"
  echo "start failed (process exited); see $LOGDIR/runner-daemon.log" >&2
  clear_stale_pidfile
  return 1
}

cmd_start() { do_start manual; }
cmd_autostart() { do_start auto; }

cmd_stop() {
  take_lock 30
  # Marker first so a racing profile hook cannot revive the runner.
  printf 'stopped_pt=%s by=runner_ctl_stop\n' "$(ts)" >"$STOP_MARKER"
  local -a pids=()
  mapfile -t pids < <(find_runner_pids)
  if (( ${#pids[@]} == 0 )); then
    rm -f "$PIDFILE"
    log "stop: none running (marker set)"
    echo "stopped"
    return 0
  fi
  log "stop requested pids=${pids[*]}"
  kill -TERM "${pids[@]}" 2>/dev/null || true
  local i alive
  for (( i = 0; i < STOP_GRACE_SEC * 2; i++ )); do
    alive=0
    for p in "${pids[@]}"; do
      if kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; then alive=1; fi
    done
    (( alive )) || break
    sleep 0.5
  done
  for p in "${pids[@]}"; do
    if kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; then
      log "stop escalate KILL pid=$p"
      kill -KILL "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  done
  # Any runner that appeared during the stop window (should be none).
  mapfile -t pids < <(find_runner_pids)
  if (( ${#pids[@]} > 0 )); then
    log "stop: late runners ${pids[*]} -> KILL"
    kill -KILL "${pids[@]}" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  rm -f "$PIDFILE"
  log "stopped (marker $STOP_MARKER)"
  echo "stopped"
  return 0
}

cmd_install_reboot() {
  # Best-effort reboot revive. Prefer cron @reboot when available; always
  # install shell/profile hooks as a durable backup on this tini/pod-daemon box
  # (cron package is often absent and SysV rc.local is not run by PID 1).
  local rc=0
  local line="@reboot $ROOT/box/runner_ctl.sh start >>$ROOT/runner-logs/runner-ctl.log 2>&1"

  if command -v crontab >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    local existing
    existing="$(crontab -l 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if printf '%s\n' "$existing" | grep -Fqx "$line"; then
      echo "@reboot already installed"
    else
      {
        printf '%s\n' "$existing"
        printf '%s\n' "$line"
      } | crontab -
      echo "installed: $line"
    fi
  else
    echo "cron/crontab not available; skipping @reboot (no install candidate on this image)"
    rc=0
  fi

  # Shell/profile hooks (survive box file persistence; revive on login/interactive shells)
  local hook="$ROOT/box/autostart_hook.sh"
  local marker_begin="# >>> degen-trading-runner autostart >>>"
  local marker_end="# <<< degen-trading-runner autostart <<<"
  local hook_line="[ -x $ROOT/box/autostart_hook.sh ] && $ROOT/box/autostart_hook.sh"

  if [[ ! -x "$hook" ]]; then
    echo "missing autostart hook: $hook" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  _degen_strip_block() {
    local src="$1" dest="$2"
    if [[ -f "$src" ]]; then
      awk -v b="$marker_begin" -v e="$marker_end" '
        $0==b {skip=1; next}
        $0==e {skip=0; next}
        !skip {print}
      ' "$src" >"$dest"
    else
      : >"$dest"
    fi
  }

  # ~/.profile — append block
  local tmp
  tmp="$(mktemp)"
  _degen_strip_block "$HOME/.profile" "$tmp"
  {
    cat "$tmp"
    printf '\n%s\n' "$marker_begin"
    printf '%s\n' "# Revive box trading runner after reboot (idempotent; no secrets printed)."
    printf '%s\n' "$hook_line"
    printf '%s\n' "$marker_end"
  } >"${tmp}.out"
  cp "${tmp}.out" "$HOME/.profile"
  echo "installed shell hook: $HOME/.profile"

  # ~/.bashrc — insert before interactive early-return
  _degen_strip_block "$HOME/.bashrc" "$tmp"
  awk -v begin="$marker_begin" -v end="$marker_end" -v hook="$hook_line" '
    BEGIN {inserted=0}
    /^case \$- in/ && !inserted {
      print begin
      print "# Revive box trading runner after reboot (idempotent; no secrets printed)."
      print "# Placed before interactive guard so login shells sourcing bashrc still run it."
      print hook
      print end
      print ""
      inserted=1
    }
    {print}
    END {
      if (!inserted) {
        print ""
        print begin
        print hook
        print end
      }
    }
  ' "$tmp" >"${tmp}.out"
  cp "${tmp}.out" "$HOME/.bashrc"
  echo "installed shell hook: $HOME/.bashrc"

  # /etc/profile.d when writable via passwordless sudo
  if sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then
    sudo tee /etc/profile.d/degen-trading-runner.sh >/dev/null <<EOF
# Revive box trading runner after reboot (idempotent; no secrets printed).
$marker_begin
$hook_line
$marker_end
EOF
    sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/degen-trading-runner.sh
    echo "installed profile.d: /etc/profile.d/degen-trading-runner.sh"
  else
    echo "sudo not available; skipped /etc/profile.d"
  fi

  rm -f "$tmp" "${tmp}.out"
  return "$rc"
}

usage() {
  echo "usage: $0 start|stop|status|autostart|install-reboot"
}

case "${1:-}" in
  start) cmd_start ;;
  stop) cmd_stop ;;
  status) cmd_status ;;
  autostart) cmd_autostart ;;
  install-reboot) cmd_install_reboot ;;
  *) usage; exit 2 ;;
esac

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Phase 2 switch, box side (template). Run by the agent; no owner question.
# Order: set PC mode -> publish mode.json (shared flag) -> stop hosted runner -> remove box cron
#        -> MIRROR_ONLY -> verify stopped. Only after "HOSTED_STOPPED_OK" may the PC tasks be enabled.
# The agent must ALSO pause/delete any Grok Bot routine that runs this bot (not reachable from here).
set -uo pipefail
ROOT="${DEGEN_HOME:-$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)}"
cd "$ROOT" || exit 1
PY="$ROOT/.venv/bin/python"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=python3

# 1. Local mode flag -> pc (box runner exits at its next cycle; box sends are refused).
"$PY" - <<'PYEOF'
import json, pathlib
p = pathlib.Path("config.json"); c = json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else {}
c["run_side"] = "pc"; p.write_text(json.dumps(c, indent=2)); print("config run_side=pc")
PYEOF

# 2. Shared flag on the owner's Worker: mode.json {"run_side":"pc"}; also clears Worker cron triggers.
DEGEN_RUN_SIDE=pc "$PY" dashboard_publish.py --force >/dev/null 2>&1 || "$PY" dashboard_publish.py >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  || echo "WARN dashboard publish failed; mode.json not updated (local flags still block the box)"

# 3. Stop the hosted runner and keep it stopped.
"$ROOT/box/runner_ctl.sh" stop || true
touch "$ROOT/MIRROR_ONLY" "$ROOT/runner.stopped"

# 4. Remove this bot's lines from the box crontab (other entries kept).
if command -v crontab >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  # Drop lines naming this folder literally, our own DEGEN_HOME=<this folder> line, and every
  # $DEGEN_HOME job while that variable points here. Other bots' lines and variables are kept.
  crontab -l 2>/dev/null | awk -v root="$ROOT" '
    /^[[:space:]]*DEGEN_HOME=/ { v=$0; sub(/^[[:space:]]*DEGEN_HOME=/, "", v); gsub(/["'"'"']/, "", v); ours=(v==root); if (ours) next; print; next }
    index($0, root) { next }
    ours && index($0, "$DEGEN_HOME") { next }
    { print }' | crontab - 2>/dev/null || true
fi

# 5. Verify.
sleep 2
if pgrep -f "$ROOT/box_runner.py" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "HOSTED_STOP_FAILED runner still alive"; exit 2
fi
if crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -q -F -e "$ROOT" -e "DEGEN_HOME=$ROOT"; then
  echo "HOSTED_STOP_FAILED cron entries remain"; exit 2
fi
echo "HOSTED_STOPPED_OK (now pause/delete the Grok Bot routine, then enable PC tasks)"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Box-local wallet edge-check runner (no AI agent).

Runs _edge_check_run.py on a fixed 6-minute start-to-start cadence.
Posts an alert webhook only when something happened (fill, trade_fail,
hard_blocker, stop, or 3 consecutive runner crashes/timeouts).

Never prints SOLANA_TRADING_PRIVATE_KEY or solana_rpc._RPC_URLS.
Does not start itself; use runner_ctl.sh.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import degen_home as _DH  # portable base dir (pcmove 2026-10-10)
import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from degen_home import TZ_NAME as _TZ_NAME

PT = ZoneInfo(_TZ_NAME)
ROOT = Path(_DH.HOME_STR)
CHECKER = ROOT / "_edge_check_run.py"
VENV_PYTHON = _DH.VENV_PY if _DH.VENV_PY.exists() else Path(sys.executable)  # template: fall back to current python
LOG_DIR = ROOT / "runner-logs"
LOCK_PATH = ROOT / "runner.lock"
HEARTBEAT_PATH = ROOT / "runner-heartbeat.json"
SCHEDULE_PATH = ROOT / "next-check-schedule.json"
CADENCE_PATH = ROOT / "cadence.json"
EVAL_PATH = ROOT / "last-check.eval.json"

INTERVAL_SEC = _DH.check_interval_sec()  # template: configurable (box 300 s / PC 60 s default)
CHECK_TIMEOUT_SEC = 8 * 60
LOG_KEEP_DAYS = 3  # template: trimmed for use (check-in needs 24 h)
CONSEC_FAIL_ALERT = 3

# Env keys the checker / webhook need. Load by NAME only; never log values.
SECRET_ENV_NAMES = (
    "SOLANA_TRADING_PRIVATE_KEY",
    "TRADING_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL",
    "TRADING_ALERT_WEBHOOK_KEY",
)

# Solana tx signatures are base58, typically 86–88 chars; also scrub shorter hashes.
_SIG_RE = re.compile(r"\b[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{64,128}\b")
_SIG_JSON_RE = re.compile(
    r'("(?:signature|sig|tx|txid)"\s*:\s*")[^"]+(")',
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_URL_RE = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s\"']+", re.IGNORECASE)


def now_pt() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(PT)


def iso_pt(dt: datetime | None = None) -> str:
    d = (dt or now_pt()).astimezone(PT).replace(microsecond=0)
    return d.isoformat()


def load_box_secrets_into_env() -> list[str]:
    """Copy named secrets from box-secrets card into os.environ if missing.

    Returns the list of env NAMES that were set or already present (never values).
    """
    return _DH.load_secrets_into_env(SECRET_ENV_NAMES)


def scrub_line(line: str) -> str:
    """Remove signatures and URLs from a log line before webhook/summary use."""
    s = _SIG_JSON_RE.sub(r"\1[sig_redacted]\2", line)
    s = _SIG_RE.sub("[sig_redacted]", s)
    s = _URL_RE.sub("[url_redacted]", s)
    # Belt-and-suspenders: never leak env secret values if they somehow appear.
    for name in SECRET_ENV_NAMES:
        val = os.environ.get(name) or ""
        if len(val) >= 8 and val in s:
            s = s.replace(val, f"[{name}_redacted]")
    try:
        import solana_rpc as _sr  # noqa: WPS433 — local package

        s = _sr.redact(s)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return s


def rotate_logs(today: str) -> None:
    LOG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cutoff = (now_pt() - timedelta(days=LOG_KEEP_DAYS)).date()
    # Only YYYY-MM-DD.log daily files; other logs fail strptime and are kept.
    for path in LOG_DIR.glob("*.log"):
        try:
            d = datetime.strptime(path.stem, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if d < cutoff:
            try:
                path.unlink()
            except OSError:
                pass


_LAST_ROTATE_DAY: str | None = None
_LAST_SIZE_CHECK = 0.0


def _size_valve() -> None:
    """Hourly stat of sol-usdc-log.md; trims oldest sections only if over 350 MB, to under 300 MB (logdiet)."""
    global _LAST_SIZE_CHECK
    import time as _t
    if _t.monotonic() - _LAST_SIZE_CHECK < 3600 and _LAST_SIZE_CHECK:
        return
    _LAST_SIZE_CHECK = _t.monotonic()
    try:
        import prune_log
        res = prune_log.maybe_prune_by_size()
        if res:
            with (LOG_DIR / f"{now_pt().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}.log").open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
                f.write(f"LOG_SIZE_PRUNE {json.dumps(res)}\n")
    except Exception as e:
        try:
            with (LOG_DIR / f"{now_pt().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}.log").open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
                f.write(f"LOG_SIZE_PRUNE_ERR {type(e).__name__}\n")
        except Exception:
            pass


def append_log(text: str) -> Path:
    global _LAST_ROTATE_DAY
    today = now_pt().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    if _LAST_ROTATE_DAY != today:  # prune old daily logs once per day (slimlog)
        rotate_logs(today)
        _LAST_ROTATE_DAY = today
    _size_valve()
    path = LOG_DIR / f"{today}.log"
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        f.write(text)
        if not text.endswith("\n"):
            f.write("\n")
    return path


_FULL_LOG_MARKERS = (
    "TRADE_FAIL", "NOTIFY_USER", "EXEC_ERR", "EXEC ", "Traceback", "HARD_BLOCKER",
    "MULTI_FILL_DONE", "STOP_HIT", "DAY_LOSS_STOP", "SEND", "_ERR", "LATE_FILL",
)


def compact_skip_line(start_iso: str, run: dict) -> str | None:
    """One summary line for a clean quiet SKIP; None means write full stdout.

    Full output is kept for FILL, errors, non-zero exit, timeout, any send
    attempt, or any unexpected error marker in the checker output.
    """
    if run.get("timed_out") or not run.get("ok") or run.get("returncode") != 0:
        return None
    combined = run.get("combined") or ""
    summary = None
    outcome = None
    for raw in combined.splitlines():
        st = raw.strip()
        if st.startswith("LOG_SUMMARY "):
            try:
                summary = json.loads(st[len("LOG_SUMMARY "):])
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                return None
        elif st.startswith("RESULT ") or st.startswith("RESULT\t"):
            parts = st.split(None, 1)
            outcome = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) == 2 else None
        elif any(m in st for m in _FULL_LOG_MARKERS) and not st.startswith("DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT reason="):
            return None
    if not isinstance(summary, dict) or outcome != "SKIP" or summary.get("result") != "SKIP":
        return None
    if summary.get("send_attempt"):
        return None
    return scrub_line(
        f"{start_iso} SKIP elapsed={run.get('elapsed_sec')}s "
        f"closest={summary.get('closest')} gap={summary.get('gap_pct')}%/{summary.get('gap_net_pct')}% "
        f"quiet={summary.get('quiet')}/{summary.get('quiet_thr')} blocked={summary.get('blocked')}"
    )


def write_json(path: Path, obj: dict) -> None:
    tmp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2) + "\n")
    tmp.replace(path)


def update_schedule(next_at: datetime, result: str) -> None:
    """Keep next-check-schedule.json current for the morning watchdog (fixed 6m)."""
    next_iso = iso_pt(next_at)
    now_iso = iso_pt()
    cron = (
        f"CRON_TZ={_TZ_NAME} {next_at.minute} {next_at.hour} "
        f"{next_at.day} {next_at.month} *"
    )
    sched = {
        "updated_pt": now_iso,
        "delay_min": 6,
        "next_at_pt": next_iso,
        "cron": cron,
        "result": result,
        "random_min": 6,
        "random_max": 6,
        "runner": "box_runner",
        "cadence_sec": INTERVAL_SEC,
    }
    write_json(SCHEDULE_PATH, sched)
    try:
        cad = json.loads(CADENCE_PATH.read_text()) if CADENCE_PATH.exists() else {}
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        cad = {}
    if not isinstance(cad, dict):
        cad = {}
    cad.update(
        {
            "updated_pt": now_iso,
            "mode": "fixed_6",
            "delay_min": 6,
            "delay_min_remaining_approx": 6,
            "next_at_pt": next_iso,
            "cron": cron,
            "result": result,
            "random_min": 6,
            "random_max": 6,
            "runner": "box_runner",
        }
    )
    write_json(CADENCE_PATH, cad)


def write_heartbeat(
    *,
    last_start: str | None,
    last_end: str | None,
    last_result: str | None,
    next_at_pt: str,
    extra: dict | None = None,
) -> None:
    obj = {
        "updated_pt": iso_pt(),
        "last_start": last_start,
        "last_end": last_end,
        "last_result": last_result,
        "next_at_pt": next_at_pt,
        "interval_sec": INTERVAL_SEC,
        "check_timeout_sec": CHECK_TIMEOUT_SEC,
        "pid": os.getpid(),
    }
    if extra:
        obj.update(extra)
    write_json(HEARTBEAT_PATH, obj)


def _log_webhook_resp(payload: dict, status: int, raw: bytes, url: str, key: str) -> None:
    """Log HTTP status + response body (<=500 chars), scrubbed of URL/key."""
    try:
        txt = (raw or b"").decode("utf-8", "replace")
        for secret in (key, url):
            if secret:
                txt = txt.replace(secret, "[redacted]")
        txt = re.sub(r"https?://\S+", "[url]", txt)
        txt = re.sub(r"(?i)(key|token|secret|bearer)([\"'=: ]+)[A-Za-z0-9._\-]{8,}", r"\1\2[redacted]", txt)
        txt = " ".join(txt.split())[:500]
        append_log(f"{iso_pt()} WEBHOOK_RESP kind={payload.get('kind')} http={status} body={txt!r}")
    except Exception:
        pass


def post_webhook(payload: dict) -> int:
    """POST JSON alert. Returns HTTP status (or 0 on local failure). Never prints the key."""
    url = (os.environ.get("TRADING_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL") or "").strip()
    key = (os.environ.get("TRADING_ALERT_WEBHOOK_KEY") or "").strip()
    if not url:
        append_log(f"{iso_pt()} WEBHOOK_SKIP missing TRADING_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL kind={payload.get('kind')}")
        return 0
    body = json.dumps(payload, default=str).encode("utf-8")
    headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "User-Agent": "degen-trading-box-runner/1.0",
    }
    if key:
        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {key}"
        headers["X-Webhook-Key"] = key
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=headers, method="POST")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
            st = int(getattr(resp, "status", 0) or 0)
            _log_webhook_resp(payload, st, resp.read(2000), url, key)
            return st
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        try:
            rb = e.read(2000)
        except Exception:
            rb = b""
        _log_webhook_resp(payload, int(e.code or 0), rb, url, key)
        return int(e.code or 0)
    except Exception as e:
        append_log(f"{iso_pt()} WEBHOOK_ERR {type(e).__name__}")
        return 0


def parse_markers(combined: str) -> dict:
    """Parse checker stdout/stderr for alert-worthy markers."""
    lines = combined.splitlines()
    result_outcome: str | None = None
    trade_fail_lines: list[str] = []
    notify_lines: list[str] = []
    hard_blocker_lines: list[str] = []
    stop_lines: list[str] = []
    fill_lines: list[str] = []
    late_fill_lines: list[str] = []
    relevant: list[str] = []

    for raw in lines:
        line = raw.rstrip("\n")
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped:
            continue
        upper = stripped.upper()

        if stripped.startswith("RESULT ") or stripped.startswith("RESULT\t"):
            parts = stripped.split(None, 1)
            if len(parts) == 2:
                result_outcome = parts[1].strip()
                relevant.append(scrub_line(stripped))
                if result_outcome == "FILL":
                    fill_lines.append(scrub_line(stripped))
                elif result_outcome == "HARD_BLOCKER":
                    hard_blocker_lines.append(scrub_line(stripped))

        if stripped.startswith("- LATE_FILL ") or stripped.startswith("LATE_FILL "):
            lf = scrub_line(stripped[2:] if stripped.startswith("- ") else stripped)
            if lf not in late_fill_lines:
                late_fill_lines.append(lf)
                relevant.append(lf)

        if stripped.startswith("TRADE_FAIL") and "PAPER_TRADING: send skipped" not in stripped:
            trade_fail_lines.append(scrub_line(stripped))
            relevant.append(scrub_line(stripped))

        if stripped.startswith("NOTIFY_USER trade_failed"):
            notify_lines.append(scrub_line(stripped))
            relevant.append(scrub_line(stripped))

        # Dedicated stop markers (agent-era wording); checker may not emit these.
        if (
            "DAY_LOSS_STOP" in upper
            or "WEEKLY_USAGE_STOP" in upper
            or "DAY-LOSS STOP" in upper
            or "DAY LOSS STOP" in upper
            or "WEEKLY USAGE STOP" in upper
            or stripped.startswith("STOP ")
            or stripped.startswith("STOP_HIT")
        ):
            # Ignore NEXT / normal schedule noise
            if not stripped.startswith("NEXT "):
                stop_lines.append(scrub_line(stripped))
                relevant.append(scrub_line(stripped))

        if "HARD_BLOCKER" in stripped and not stripped.startswith("RESULT "):
            # e.g. notes or skip_edge_halving line
            if "skip_edge_halving unchanged (HARD_BLOCKER)" in stripped:
                hard_blocker_lines.append(scrub_line(stripped))
                relevant.append(scrub_line(stripped))

        if stripped.startswith("MULTI_FILL_DONE") or stripped.startswith("EXEC "):
            if result_outcome == "FILL" or stripped.startswith("MULTI_FILL_DONE"):
                fill_lines.append(scrub_line(stripped))
                relevant.append(scrub_line(stripped))

    # Post-run eval file: day_loss_stop.hit (checker currently folds this into HARD_BLOCKER)
    day_loss_hit = False
    try:
        if EVAL_PATH.exists():
            ev = json.loads(EVAL_PATH.read_text())
            ds = ev.get("day_loss_stop") if isinstance(ev, dict) else None
            if isinstance(ds, dict) and ds.get("hit"):
                day_loss_hit = True
                stop_lines.append(
                    scrub_line(
                        f"DAY_LOSS_STOP hit status={ds.get('status')} "
                        f"reason={ds.get('reason')}"
                    )
                )
                relevant.append(stop_lines[-1])
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        pass

    return {
        "result_outcome": result_outcome,
        "trade_fail_lines": trade_fail_lines,
        "notify_lines": notify_lines,
        "hard_blocker_lines": hard_blocker_lines,
        "stop_lines": stop_lines,
        "fill_lines": fill_lines,
        "late_fill_lines": late_fill_lines,
        "relevant": relevant,
        "day_loss_hit": day_loss_hit,
        "has_trade_fail": bool(trade_fail_lines or notify_lines),
        # empty wallet (no SOL/USDC/cbBTC/WETH): None when the check didn't report it
        "wallet_empty": (True if "MIGRATION_BLOCKER True" in combined
                         else False if "MIGRATION_BLOCKER False" in combined else None),
    }


AWAIT_DEPOSIT_STATE = ROOT / "awaiting-deposit.json"


def _awaiting_deposit(rearm: bool = False) -> bool:
    """rearm=True: wallet holds funds, clear the sent flag. Else: True exactly once per empty spell."""
    try:
        st = json.loads(AWAIT_DEPOSIT_STATE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        st = {}
    if rearm:
        if st.get("sent"):
            AWAIT_DEPOSIT_STATE.write_text(json.dumps({"sent": False}), encoding="utf-8")
        return False
    if st.get("sent"):
        return False
    AWAIT_DEPOSIT_STATE.write_text(json.dumps({"sent": True, "at": iso_pt()}), encoding="utf-8")
    return True


def _awaiting_deposit_alert(t: str) -> dict:
    return {"kind": "awaiting_deposit", "time_pt": t,
            "summary": "Your wallet's empty right now, so there's nothing for me to trade yet. "
                       "I'll stay quiet until your first deposit shows up.",
            "lines": []}


def decide_alerts(parsed: dict, run_meta: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """Build zero or more webhook payloads for this check."""
    alerts: list[dict] = []
    t = iso_pt()
    outcome = parsed.get("result_outcome")

    if outcome == "FILL" or parsed.get("fill_lines"):
        lines = parsed["fill_lines"] or [f"RESULT {outcome}"]
        alerts.append(
            {
                "kind": "fill",
                "time_pt": t,
                "summary": "I just made a trade. The details are below and on your dashboard.",
                "lines": lines[:40],
            }
        )

    if parsed.get("late_fill_lines"):
        # Not a fill alert (those stay muted) and not a trade failure: it does not
        # count toward or reset the consecutive-fail counter.
        lines = parsed["late_fill_lines"]
        alerts.append(
            {
                "kind": "late_fill",
                "type": "late_fill",
                "time_pt": t,
                "summary": (
                    f"Good news: {'a trade I thought had failed' if len(lines) == 1 else str(len(lines)) + ' trades I thought had failed'} "
                    "actually went through. I've now logged it in your trade history, so your numbers are right."
                ),
                "lines": lines[:40],
                "counts_toward_fail_streak": False,
                "notify_owner": True,
            }
        )

    if parsed.get("has_trade_fail"):
        lines = list(parsed["trade_fail_lines"]) + list(parsed["notify_lines"])
        alerts.append(
            {
                "kind": "trade_fail",
                "time_pt": t,
                "summary": "A trade didn't go through. Nothing was lost, and I'll keep checking prices as usual. The technical details are below.",
                "lines": [scrub_line(x) for x in lines[:40]],
            }
        )

    if parsed.get("wallet_empty") is False:
        _awaiting_deposit(rearm=True)  # wallet funded: a later empty wallet gets one new notice
    if (outcome == "HARD_BLOCKER" or parsed.get("hard_blocker_lines")) and parsed.get("wallet_empty") \
            and not parsed.get("day_loss_hit") and not parsed.get("stop_lines"):
        # template: an empty wallet is not an error. ONE "awaiting your first deposit" notice, then quiet
        # until a deposit lands; re-armed only after the wallet held funds again.
        if _awaiting_deposit():
            alerts.append(_awaiting_deposit_alert(t))
    elif outcome == "HARD_BLOCKER" or parsed.get("hard_blocker_lines"):
        lines = parsed["hard_blocker_lines"] or [f"RESULT {outcome}"]
        alerts.append(
            {
                "kind": "hard_blocker",
                "time_pt": t,
                "summary": "Something is stopping me from trading right now, so I'm sitting this check out. The details are below.",
                "lines": lines[:40],
            }
        )

    if parsed.get("stop_lines") or parsed.get("day_loss_hit"):
        lines = parsed["stop_lines"] or ["stop triggered"]
        alerts.append(
            {
                "kind": "stop",
                "time_pt": t,
                "summary": "I've paused trading for now because one of my safety limits was hit. I'll pick back up on my own when it clears.",
                "lines": lines[:40],
            }
        )

    if run_meta.get("runner_error_alert"):
        alerts.append(
            {
                "kind": "runner_error",
                "time_pt": t,
                "summary": run_meta.get("runner_error_summary")
                or f"My price check has failed {CONSEC_FAIL_ALERT} times in a row. I'll keep retrying.",
                "lines": [scrub_line(x) for x in (run_meta.get("runner_error_lines") or [])[:40]],
            }
        )

    return alerts


def run_checker_once() -> dict:
    """Run one edge check with hard timeout. Does not print secrets."""
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env.setdefault("PYTHONUTF8", "1")
    env.setdefault("PYTHONIOENCODING", "utf-8")
    # Ensure secrets loaded for child
    load_box_secrets_into_env()
    for name in SECRET_ENV_NAMES:
        if name in os.environ:
            env[name] = os.environ[name]

    cmd = [str(VENV_PYTHON), str(CHECKER)]
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            cmd,
            cwd=str(ROOT),
            env=env,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="replace",
            timeout=CHECK_TIMEOUT_SEC,
        )
        elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
        stdout = proc.stdout or ""
        stderr = proc.stderr or ""
        return {
            "ok": proc.returncode == 0,
            "returncode": proc.returncode,
            "timed_out": False,
            "elapsed_sec": round(elapsed, 2),
            "stdout": stdout,
            "stderr": stderr,
            "combined": stdout + ("\n" + stderr if stderr else ""),
        }
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
        elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
        stdout = (e.stdout or "") if isinstance(e.stdout, str) else (
            e.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if e.stdout else ""
        )
        stderr = (e.stderr or "") if isinstance(e.stderr, str) else (
            e.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if e.stderr else ""
        )
        return {
            "ok": False,
            "returncode": -9,
            "timed_out": True,
            "elapsed_sec": round(elapsed, 2),
            "stdout": stdout,
            "stderr": stderr,
            "combined": stdout + ("\n" + stderr if stderr else "") + "\nRUNNER_TIMEOUT\n",
        }
    except Exception as e:
        elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
        return {
            "ok": False,
            "returncode": -1,
            "timed_out": False,
            "elapsed_sec": round(elapsed, 2),
            "stdout": "",
            "stderr": f"RUNNER_SPAWN_ERR {type(e).__name__}",
            "combined": f"RUNNER_SPAWN_ERR {type(e).__name__}\n",
        }


def acquire_lock():
    LOG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fh = open(LOCK_PATH, "a+", encoding="utf-8")
    if not _DH.try_lock(fh):
        fh.close()
        print("another runner holds the lock; exiting", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
    fh.seek(0)
    fh.truncate()
    fh.write(f"pid={os.getpid()} started={iso_pt()}\n")
    fh.flush()
    return fh



def _template_seed_gate() -> bool:
    """Template: True when every pair has a starting rate. If not and config seed_mode is "deposit",
    try seeding from the first deposit (live quotes) right now. Never trades while unseeded."""
    try:
        cb = json.loads((ROOT / "cost-basis.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return False
    if all(p.get("rate") for p in (cb.get("pairs") or {}).values()):
        return True
    if (_DH.config().get("seed_mode") or "").lower() == "deposit":
        import subprocess
        r = subprocess.run([str(sys.executable), str(ROOT / "seed_prices.py"), "--mode", "deposit"],
                           cwd=str(ROOT), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
        append_log(f"{iso_pt()} SEED_DEPOSIT_CHECK rc={r.returncode}")
        if r.returncode == 2 and _awaiting_deposit():
            # New wallet still empty: checks don't run until the first deposit seeds prices,
            # so the ONE awaiting-deposit notice goes out from here (then quiet until funded).
            try:
                st = post_webhook(_awaiting_deposit_alert(iso_pt()))
                append_log(f"{iso_pt()} WEBHOOK_POST kind=awaiting_deposit http={st}")
            except Exception as _aw_err:
                append_log(f"{iso_pt()} WEBHOOK_ERR kind=awaiting_deposit {type(_aw_err).__name__}")
        if r.returncode == 0:
            _awaiting_deposit(rearm=True)
        return r.returncode == 0 and _template_seed_gate_done()
    append_log(f"{iso_pt()} WAITING_FOR_SEED run seed_prices.py (deposit / test-trade / manual)")
    return False


def _template_seed_gate_done() -> bool:
    try:
        cb = json.loads((ROOT / "cost-basis.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        return all(p.get("rate") for p in (cb.get("pairs") or {}).values())
    except Exception:
        return False


def main_loop() -> int:
    if _DH.MIRROR_FLAG.exists():
        # Box mirror guard (2026-10-10): the live bot runs on the owner's PC.
        append_log(f"{iso_pt()} RUNNER_REFUSED MIRROR_ONLY present; this copy must not trade")
        print("MIRROR_ONLY present: this copy is a mirror and must not trade; refusing to start", file=sys.stderr)
        return 3
    if not _DH.run_side_ok():
        append_log(f"{iso_pt()} RUNNER_REFUSED run_side={_DH.run_side()} this_side={_DH.THIS_SIDE}")
        print(f"run_side is {_DH.run_side()!r}; this is the {_DH.THIS_SIDE!r} side; refusing to start", file=sys.stderr)
        return 3
    load_box_secrets_into_env()
    if not (os.environ.get("SOLANA_TRADING_PRIVATE_KEY") or "").strip():
        append_log(f"{iso_pt()} FATAL missing SOLANA_TRADING_PRIVATE_KEY (env/box-secrets card)")
        print("missing SOLANA_TRADING_PRIVATE_KEY", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    lock_fh = acquire_lock()
    consec_fails = 0
    append_log(f"{iso_pt()} RUNNER_START pid={os.getpid()} interval_sec={INTERVAL_SEC}")

    # Graceful stop on SIGTERM/SIGINT
    stopping = {"flag": False}

    def _stop(signum, frame):  # noqa: ARG001
        stopping["flag"] = True
        append_log(f"{iso_pt()} RUNNER_SIGNAL {signum}")

    for _sig in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT, getattr(signal, "SIGBREAK", None)):
        if _sig is not None:
            try:
                signal.signal(_sig, _stop)
            except (ValueError, OSError):
                pass

    try:
        while not stopping["flag"]:
            if not _DH.run_side_ok():  # template: side switched mid-run -> stop, never double trade
                append_log(f"{iso_pt()} RUNNER_EXIT run_side={_DH.run_side()} this_side={_DH.THIS_SIDE}")
                break
            if _DH.trading_paused():  # template kill switch: no checks, no trades while paused
                append_log(f"{iso_pt()} PAUSED (TRADING_PAUSED) - skipping check")
                for _ in range(INTERVAL_SEC):
                    if stopping["flag"] or not _DH.trading_paused():
                        break
                    time.sleep(1)
                continue
            if not _template_seed_gate():
                for _ in range(INTERVAL_SEC):
                    if stopping["flag"]:
                        break
                    time.sleep(1)
                continue
            cycle_start = now_pt()
            next_at = _DH.next_jittered(cycle_start, INTERVAL_SEC)  # v1.0.0: per-install offset within the interval
            start_iso = iso_pt(cycle_start)
            next_iso = iso_pt(next_at)

            write_heartbeat(
                last_start=start_iso,
                last_end=None,
                last_result="running",
                next_at_pt=next_iso,
            )
            # Pre-announce for watchdog in case the check is long
            update_schedule(next_at, "running")

            run = run_checker_once()
            compact = compact_skip_line(start_iso, run)
            if compact is not None:
                # Quiet SKIP with no send attempt: one summary line (slimlog 2026-10-11).
                append_log(compact)
            else:
                append_log(f"\n===== {start_iso} check start =====")
                # Scrub before persisting anything that might hold RPC URLs
                combined_scrubbed = "\n".join(
                    scrub_line(ln) for ln in (run["combined"] or "").splitlines()
                )
                append_log(combined_scrubbed)
                append_log(
                    f"===== {iso_pt()} check end rc={run['returncode']} "
                    f"timed_out={run['timed_out']} elapsed_sec={run['elapsed_sec']} ====="
                )

            parsed = parse_markers(run["combined"] or "")
            outcome = parsed.get("result_outcome") or (
                "TIMEOUT" if run["timed_out"] else f"EXIT_{run['returncode']}"
            )

            run_meta: dict = {}
            failed = (not run["ok"]) or run["timed_out"]
            if failed:
                consec_fails += 1
            else:
                consec_fails = 0

            if consec_fails >= CONSEC_FAIL_ALERT and failed:
                run_meta["runner_error_alert"] = True
                run_meta["runner_error_summary"] = (
                    f"My price check has failed {consec_fails} times in a row, so I may be missing trades. "
                    f"I'll keep retrying. If it keeps happening, ask me to take a look."
                )
                tail = (run["combined"] or "").strip().splitlines()[-15:]
                run_meta["runner_error_lines"] = [
                    scrub_line(x) for x in tail
                ] or [f"rc={run['returncode']} timed_out={run['timed_out']}"]
                # Reset so we don't alert every subsequent failure forever;
                # require another full streak.
                consec_fails = 0

            alerts = decide_alerts(parsed, run_meta)
            for payload in alerts:
                status = post_webhook(payload)
                append_log(
                    f"{iso_pt()} WEBHOOK_POST kind={payload.get('kind')} http={status}"
                )

            # Dashboard snapshot: after every check (keeps quiet streak / runner fresh)
            # and always after fills. Desktop CopyFromBox CANCELLED. Never wakes chat.
            try:
                import dashboard_snapshot as _dash
                _r = "box_runner_fill" if (outcome == "FILL" or parsed.get("fill_lines")) else "box_runner_check"
                _dash.refresh(reason=_r)
                append_log(f"{iso_pt()} DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT reason={_r}")
            except Exception as _dash_err:
                append_log(f"{iso_pt()} DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_ERR {type(_dash_err).__name__}")

            # Publish dashboard to Cloudflare Worker (your-dashboard.example.com). Detached,
            # non-blocking; the script dedupes by hash and logs to
            # runner-logs/dashboard-publish.log. Errors here never affect trading.
            try:
                subprocess.Popen(
                    [str(VENV_PYTHON), str(ROOT / "dashboard_publish.py")],
                    cwd=str(ROOT),
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    close_fds=True,
                    **_DH.detached_popen_kwargs(),
                )
            except Exception as _pub_err:
                append_log(f"{iso_pt()} DASHBOARD_PUBLISH_ERR {type(_pub_err).__name__}")

            end_iso = iso_pt()
            # Checker may have overwritten schedule with random 10–25; restore fixed 6m.
            update_schedule(next_at, outcome if not run["timed_out"] else "TIMEOUT")
            write_heartbeat(
                last_start=start_iso,
                last_end=end_iso,
                last_result=outcome,
                next_at_pt=next_iso,
                extra={
                    "last_returncode": run["returncode"],
                    "last_timed_out": run["timed_out"],
                    "last_elapsed_sec": run["elapsed_sec"],
                    "last_alert_kinds": [a.get("kind") for a in alerts],
                    "consecutive_fails": consec_fails,
                },
            )

            # Sleep start-to-start for INTERVAL_SEC
            while not stopping["flag"]:
                remaining = (next_at - now_pt()).total_seconds()
                if remaining <= 0:
                    break
                time.sleep(min(remaining, 5.0))
    finally:
        _DH.unlock(lock_fh)
        lock_fh.close()
        append_log(f"{iso_pt()} RUNNER_STOP pid={os.getpid()}")
    return 0


def cmd_test_webhook() -> int:
    load_box_secrets_into_env()
    status = post_webhook({"test": True, "kind": "test", "type": "test", "message": "webhook test, ignore"})
    # Print ONLY the HTTP status code (or 0)
    print(status)
    return 0 if status and 200 <= status < 300 else 1


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Box-local wallet edge-check runner")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--test-webhook",
        action="store_true",
        help="POST {test:true, kind:test} once; print only HTTP status code",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.test_webhook:
        return cmd_test_webhook()
    return main_loop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""24-hour check-in summary (template). Prints JSON for the one-shot check-in message: checks run, skips,
would-be (paper) fills, wallet value now vs funded (mark-to-market), dashboard link, paused/paper state.
Paper P&L here = wallet value change vs funded_usd (paper mode never trades) plus the count of would-be fills."""
import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

import degen_home as _DH

H = _DH.HOME


def main():
    since = datetime.now().astimezone() - timedelta(hours=24)
    checks = skips = paper = 0
    compact = r"^(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT[\d:]+[-+]\d\d:\d\d) SKIP elapsed="
    for p in sorted((H / "runner-logs").glob("????-??-??.log"))[-2:]:  # box_runner daily logs
        try:
            recent = False
            block_paper = False
            for ln in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").splitlines():
                c = re.match(compact, ln)
                if c:  # quiet SKIP written as one line (no "check start" block)
                    if datetime.fromisoformat(c.group(1)) >= since:
                        checks += 1
                        skips += 1
                    continue
                m = re.search(r"(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT[\d:]+[-+]\d\d:\d\d)", ln)
                if m and "check start" in ln:  # "===== <ts> check start =====" opens each full check
                    recent = datetime.fromisoformat(m.group(1)) >= since
                    block_paper = False
                if not recent:
                    continue
                if ln.startswith("LOG_SUMMARY "):  # one per completed check
                    checks += 1
                    try:
                        skips += json.loads(ln[len("LOG_SUMMARY "):]).get("result") == "SKIP"
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                if "PAPER_TRADING: send skipped" in ln and not block_paper:
                    paper += 1  # one would-be fill per check, however many lines mention it
                    block_paper = True
        except Exception:
            pass
    cb = json.loads((H / "cost-basis.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    funded = float((cb.get("funding") or {}).get("funded_usd") or 0)
    now_usd = None
    try:
        import seed_prices as sp
        A = sp.assets(); px = sp.live_usd_prices(A); b = sp.balances(A)
        now_usd = round(sum(b[s] * px[s] for s in b), 2)
    except Exception:
        pass
    out = {"window": "last 24h", "checks": checks, "skips": skips, "would_be_fills": paper,
           "funded_usd": funded, "wallet_usd_now": now_usd,
           "paper_pnl_usd": (round(now_usd - funded, 2) if now_usd is not None and funded else None),
           "paper_pnl_pct": (round((now_usd - funded) / funded * 100, 2) if now_usd is not None and funded else None),
           "paper_mode": _DH.paper_trading(), "paused": _DH.trading_paused(),
           "dashboard": (_DH.config().get("dashboard") or {}).get("public_url")}
    print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

=== FILE: code/daily_rebalance_v2.py | sha256=bb304d3d7d615e743ab0da0118889ceff60a9eaa7f155a0663456ce9aaa45988 | bytes=17592 ===
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Daily rebalance v2 (owner 2026-10-11) — BUILT DISABLED, planning + dry-run only.

Targets (share of the TOTAL trading book SOL+USDC+cbBTC+WETH, saved cbBTC excluded):
  1. USDC = Fear & Greed / 5 (saved daily value, market_gates.fetch_fng; no extra fetch).
  2. The rest is split across cbBTC/WETH/SOL by CoinGecko 24h volume share (usd_24h_vol of
     bitcoin/ethereum/solana — the same feed and math as the dashboard's GLOBAL VOLUME pie).
  3. Each of cbBTC/WETH/SOL clamped to [min_pct, max_pct] (20..55 since floor20 2026-10-12; was 10..55) of the total; unclamped
     crypto weights re-normalized, iterated until stable. If the bounds cannot be met with the
     F&G cash target (cash > 100 - 3*min or < 100 - 3*max) the cash target is moved to the
     nearest feasible value and reported as cash_adjusted.
  4. Swaps to reach the targets: greedy largest-overweight -> largest-underweight matching
     (at most 3 swaps for 4 assets, direct pairs; all 6 pairs are allowed). Only daily_fraction
     (1/10) of each swap's notional is executed per day; legs below min_trade_usd are skipped; no fee-loss skip
     (allow_negative_net: true, owner 2026-10-11).
Fear & Greed gates apply (block USDC buys >75 + size x0.5, block sells to USDC <25); the Kraken
VWAP rule does not (dailyv2d). Execution (dailyv2e): run_morning() from morning_balance_run at 6:59 AM PT (Degen Morning Balance task), once per PT day
(daily-rebalance-v2-state.json); each leg via execute() on the top-up send path, recorded as daily_v2.
Live sends only when daily_rebalance_v2.enabled is true.
Usage: .venv/bin/python daily_rebalance_v2.py --dry-run [--no-quotes]
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import degen_home as _DH

ROOT = Path(_DH.HOME_STR)
CRYPTO = ("cbBTC", "WETH", "SOL")
BOOK = ("SOL", "USDC", "cbBTC", "WETH")
CG_IDS = {"cbBTC": "bitcoin", "WETH": "ethereum", "SOL": "solana"}  # dashboard SHARE_COINS
CG_URL = "https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=bitcoin,ethereum,solana&vs_currencies=usd&include_24hr_vol=true"
DEFAULTS = {
    "enabled": False,
    "time_pt": "06:59",  # informational; the Windows task trigger decides
    "cash_divisor": 5.0,
    "min_pct": 20.0,  # floor20 2026-10-12: was 10%
    "max_pct": 55.0,
    "daily_fraction": 0.1,
    "min_trade_usd": 1.0,
    "apply_market_gates": False,   # superseded by the two keys below (dailyv2d)
    "apply_fear_greed": True,      # F&G >75: size x0.5 + no USDC->crypto buys; <25: no crypto->USDC sells
    "skip_vwap": True,             # v2 exempt from the Kraken 24h VWAP rule
    "respect_size_limits": True,
    "allow_negative_net": True,
    "fill_kind": "daily_v2",       # dailyv2c: recorded kind; edge reverses capped at reversal_cap_pct
    "reversal_cap_pct": 50.0,  # dailyv2b: small fee-inclusive losses allowed; no net skip
    "supersedes": ["underweight_double"],
}


def cfg_of(cb: dict) -> dict:
    c = dict(DEFAULTS)
    c.update((cb or {}).get("daily_rebalance_v2") or {})
    return c


def volume_shares(getter=None) -> dict:
    """{cbBTC, WETH, SOL: share 0..1} from CoinGecko usd_24h_vol (dashboard getShareData('vol'))."""
    if getter is None:
        import market_gates as MG
        getter = MG._get
    import keyless

    def coingecko():
        d = getter(CG_URL, 10)
        vols = {s: float((d.get(cid) or {}).get("usd_24h_vol") or 0) for s, cid in CG_IDS.items()}
        tot = sum(vols.values())
        if tot <= 0:
            raise ValueError("no_volume")
        return {s: v / tot for s, v in vols.items()}
    # v1.0.0: volume shares move slowly; last-good value usable up to 36 h, else the caller skips the run.
    v, _meta = keyless.first_ok("cg_volume_shares", [("coingecko", coingecko)], 36 * 3600)
    return v


def targets(fng: float, vol: dict, cfg: dict) -> dict:
    """Return dict with cash/ideal/clamped weights (percent of total) and notes."""
    lo, hi = float(cfg["min_pct"]), float(cfg["max_pct"])
    n = len(CRYPTO)
    cash = float(fng) / float(cfg["cash_divisor"])
    notes = []
    feas_hi, feas_lo = 100 - n * lo, max(0.0, 100 - n * hi)
    cash_adj = min(max(cash, feas_lo), feas_hi)
    if abs(cash_adj - cash) > 1e-9:
        notes.append(f"cash_adjusted {cash:.2f}% -> {cash_adj:.2f}% (bounds {lo}-{hi}% x{n} need cash in [{feas_lo:.0f},{feas_hi:.0f}])")
    rest = 100 - cash_adj
    ideal = {s: rest * vol[s] for s in CRYPTO}
    # floor20 2026-10-12: bounded proportional fill. w_s = clamp(k * vol_s, lo, hi), with k found by
    # bisection so the crypto weights sum to `rest`. Unclamped coins keep their volume ratios; works
    # when floors and caps both bind (the old one-direction pass could overshoot with a 20% floor).
    vs = {s: max(0.0, float(vol.get(s) or 0)) for s in CRYPTO}
    if sum(vs.values()) <= 0:
        vs = {s: 1.0 for s in CRYPTO}
    f = lambda k: {s: min(hi, max(lo, k * vs[s])) for s in CRYPTO}
    k_lo, k_hi = 0.0, 1.0
    while sum(f(k_hi).values()) < rest - 1e-12 and k_hi < 1e12:
        k_hi *= 2
    for _ in range(200):
        k = (k_lo + k_hi) / 2
        if sum(f(k).values()) < rest:
            k_lo = k
        else:
            k_hi = k
    w = f(k_hi)
    err = rest - sum(w.values())
    free = [s for s in CRYPTO if lo + 1e-9 < w[s] < hi - 1e-9] or list(CRYPTO)
    for s in free:
        w[s] += err / len(free)
    fixed = {s: w[s] for s in CRYPTO if abs(w[s] - lo) < 1e-6 or abs(w[s] - hi) < 1e-6}
    out = {"USDC": cash_adj, **{s: w[s] for s in CRYPTO}}
    return {"fng": fng, "cash_rule_pct": cash, "ideal": {"USDC": cash_adj, **ideal}, "target": out,
            "clamped": sorted(fixed), "notes": notes}


def swaps(cur_usd: dict, tgt_pct: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """Fewest-swaps greedy: largest surplus pays largest deficit, direct pair."""
    total = sum(cur_usd.values())
    diff = {s: cur_usd.get(s, 0.0) - total * tgt_pct[s] / 100 for s in BOOK}
    over = {s: d for s, d in diff.items() if d > 1e-9}
    under = {s: -d for s, d in diff.items() if d < -1e-9}
    out = []
    while over and under:
        so = max(over, key=over.get)
        su = max(under, key=under.get)
        amt = min(over[so], under[su])
        out.append({"sell": so, "buy": su, "usd": amt})
        over[so] -= amt
        under[su] -= amt
        if over[so] <= 1e-6:
            del over[so]
        if under[su] <= 1e-6:
            del under[su]
    return out


def daily_legs(full: list[dict], cfg: dict, bals: dict, prices: dict, cb: dict) -> list[dict]:
    frac, mn = float(cfg["daily_fraction"]), float(cfg["min_trade_usd"])
    sl = (cb or {}).get("size_limits") or {}
    max_frac = float(sl.get("max_sell_fraction_of_balance", 0.4))
    min_sol = float(sl.get("min_sol_fee_buffer", 0.02))
    legs = []
    work = dict(bals)
    for s in full:
        usd = s["usd"] * frac
        row = {"sell": s["sell"], "buy": s["buy"], "full_usd": round(s["usd"], 4), "usd": round(usd, 4)}
        px = 1.0 if s["sell"] == "USDC" else float(prices.get(s["sell"]) or 0)
        if cfg.get("respect_size_limits") and px > 0:
            bal = float(work.get(s["sell"]) or 0)
            cap = bal * max_frac
            if s["sell"] == "SOL":
                cap = min(cap, max(0.0, bal - min_sol))
            if usd > cap * px:
                row["capped_from_usd"] = row["usd"]
                usd = cap * px
                row["usd"] = round(usd, 4)
        row["sell_amt"] = usd / px if px > 0 else 0.0
        if usd < mn:
            row["skip"] = f"below_min_trade_usd({mn})"
        else:
            work[s["sell"]] = float(work.get(s["sell"]) or 0) - row["sell_amt"]
        legs.append(row)
    return legs


def apply_gates(legs: list[dict], cfg: dict, gates) -> list[dict]:
    """dailyv2d 2026-10-11: Fear & Greed rules apply (block + >75 halving), VWAP exempt."""
    if not cfg.get("apply_fear_greed") or gates is None:
        return legs
    mult = float(gates.size_mult())
    for leg in legs:
        if leg.get("skip"):
            continue
        rule = gates.block(leg["sell"], leg["buy"], skip_vwap=bool(cfg.get("skip_vwap", True)))
        if rule:
            leg["skip"] = f"market_gate:{rule}"
            continue
        if mult != 1:
            leg["greed_mult"] = mult
            leg["usd"] = round(leg["usd"] * mult, 4)
            leg["sell_amt"] *= mult
            if leg["usd"] < float(cfg["min_trade_usd"]):
                leg["skip"] = f"below_min_trade_usd({cfg['min_trade_usd']})"
    return legs


def plan(cb: dict, bals: dict, prices: dict, fng: float, vol: dict, gates=None) -> dict:
    cfg = cfg_of(cb)
    cur = {s: float(bals.get(s) or 0) * (1.0 if s == "USDC" else float(prices.get(s) or 0)) for s in BOOK}
    total = sum(cur.values())
    t = targets(fng, vol, cfg)
    full = swaps(cur, t["target"])
    return {"cfg": cfg, "total_usd": total, "current_pct": {s: cur[s] / total * 100 for s in BOOK},
            "current_usd": cur, **t, "volume_pct": {s: vol[s] * 100 for s in CRYPTO},
            "full_swaps": full, "today": apply_gates(daily_legs(full, cfg, bals, prices, cb), cfg, gates)}


STATE_PATH = ROOT / "daily-rebalance-v2-state.json"


def slot_key(now) -> str:
    """buyside1012: two runs per PT day (6:59 AM 'am', 4:59 PM 'pm'); each slot runs once."""
    return f"{now.date().isoformat()}-{'am' if now.hour < 12 else 'pm'}"


def _state(today: str) -> dict:
    try:
        st = json.loads(STATE_PATH.read_text())
    except Exception:
        st = {}
    return st if st.get("date") == today else {"date": today, "done": False, "legs": []}


def _save_state(st: dict) -> None:
    import fade_trend
    fade_trend.atomic_write_json(str(STATE_PATH), st)


def _quote(FR, MB, sold, bought, sell_amt, prices, cfg):
    """Best net of Jupiter manual (fee 0) and Raydium. allow_negative_net: no fee-loss skip."""
    sol_usd = float(prices.get("SOL") or 0)
    bpx = 1.0 if bought == "USDC" else float(prices.get(bought) or 0)
    best, _rows, started = FR.quote_winning_route(sold, bought, sell_amt, sol_usd, bpx)
    if not best:
        return None, None, started, "no_quote"
    buy_amt = int(best["out_amount"]) / (10 ** MB.DEC[bought])
    ok, net = MB.net_ok(sold, bought, sell_amt, buy_amt, best.get("gas_sol"), prices)
    if not ok and not cfg.get("allow_negative_net", True):
        return None, net, started, "net_loss_beyond_dust"
    return best, net, started, None


def execute(cb, leg, prices, dry_run=False):
    """One v2 leg on the morning top-up's send path (savings_mode.send_built_txs: dupsend guard,
    wait-then-retry, stale re-quote, rebuild on retry). Fill recorded as kind daily_v2."""
    import time
    import friday_rsi as FR
    import morning_balance_run as MB
    import savings_mode
    import venue_quotes as VQ
    cfg = cfg_of(cb)
    kind = cfg.get("fill_kind", "daily_v2")
    sold, bought, sell_amt = leg["sell"], leg["buy"], float(leg["sell_amt"])
    pair = FR._pair_of(sold, bought)
    best, net, started, why = _quote(FR, MB, sold, bought, sell_amt, prices, cfg)
    if not best:
        return {"sent": False, "error": why, "pair": pair, "net_usd": net}
    q = {"venue": best.get("venue"), "out": int(best["out_amount"]) / (10 ** MB.DEC[bought]), "net_usd": net}
    if dry_run:
        return {"sent": False, "error": "dry_run", "pair": pair, "quote": q}
    if not cfg.get("enabled"):
        return {"sent": False, "error": "disabled", "pair": pair}
    txs, err = MB._uw_build(VQ, best, sold, bought)
    if err or not txs:
        return {"sent": False, "error": err or "no_tx", "pair": pair}
    if time.monotonic() - started > FR.QUOTE_STALE_SEC:
        best, net, started, why = _quote(FR, MB, sold, bought, sell_amt, prices, cfg)
        if not best:
            return {"sent": False, "error": f"stale_requote:{why}", "pair": pair}
        txs, err = MB._uw_build(VQ, best, sold, bought)
        if err or not txs:
            return {"sent": False, "error": err or "no_tx", "pair": pair}
    holder = {"best": best}

    def _rebuild():
        b2, _n, _s, _w = _quote(FR, MB, sold, bought, sell_amt, prices, cfg)
        if not b2:
            return None
        built, e2 = MB._uw_build(VQ, b2, sold, bought)
        if e2 or not built:
            return None
        holder["best"] = b2
        return built

    kp = savings_mode._load_keypair()
    sig, err_s, uncertain = savings_mode.send_built_txs(txs, kp, _rebuild, accept_unconfirmed=False)
    if err_s or not sig:
        return {"sent": False, "error": err_s or "send_failed", "pair": pair, "submitted": bool(uncertain)}
    best = holder["best"]
    buy_amt = int(best["out_amount"]) / (10 ** MB.DEC[bought])
    base, quote = FR.PAIR_BASE_QUOTE[pair]
    amts = {sold: sell_amt, bought: float(buy_amt)}
    fill_rate = amts[quote] / amts[base]
    when = MB.now_pt().isoformat()
    FR.record_rebalance_fill(pair, sold, bought, sell_amt, buy_amt, fill_rate, sig, when, kind)
    return {"sent": True, "signature": sig, "pair": pair, "sold": sold, "bought": bought,
            "sell_amt": sell_amt, "buy_amt": buy_amt, "fill_rate": fill_rate, "kind": kind,
            "venue": best.get("venue"), "gas_sol": best.get("gas_sol"), "when_pt": when, "net_usd": net}


def run_morning(cb, bals, prices, dry_run=False, executor=None, fng=None, vol=None, gates=None):
    """Called by morning_balance_run.main() (Degen Morning Balance task, 6:59 AM and 4:59 PM PT). Once per slot (state file).
    Returns (results, note). Does nothing live unless daily_rebalance_v2.enabled."""
    import morning_balance_run as MB
    cfg = cfg_of(cb)
    if not cfg.get("enabled") and not dry_run:
        return [], "daily_rebalance_v2 disabled"
    today = slot_key(MB.now_pt())  # buyside1012: once per slot (am 6:59 / pm 4:59 PT), each 1/10 of the gap
    st = _state(today)
    if st.get("done") and not dry_run:
        return [], f"daily_rebalance_v2 already ran this slot ({today})"
    import market_gates as MG
    if fng is None:
        f = MG.fetch_fng(MG.cfgs(cb)[0])
        if f.get("value") is None:
            return [{"error": "fear_greed_unavailable", "fng": f}], "daily_rebalance_v2 skipped (no F&G)"
        fng = f["value"]
        gates = gates or MG.Gates(cb, fng=f, vwap={})
    if vol is None:
        try:
            vol = volume_shares()
        except Exception as e:
            return [{"error": f"volume_unavailable:{type(e).__name__}"}], "daily_rebalance_v2 skipped (no volume)"
    p = plan(cb, bals, prices, fng, vol, gates=gates)
    run = executor or execute
    results = []
    cur = dict(bals)  # after1012: running balances; each row's after = read after THAT fill
    for leg in p["today"]:
        if leg.get("skip"):
            results.append({"sent": False, "error": leg["skip"], "leg": leg})
            continue
        res = dict(run(cb, leg, prices, dry_run=dry_run) or {})
        res["leg"] = leg
        results.append(res)
        if res.get("sent"):
            st["legs"].append({k: res.get(k) for k in ("pair", "sold", "bought", "sell_amt", "buy_amt", "when_pt")})
            _save_state(st)
            try:
                import after_bals as _AB
                after, _src = _AB.read_after(MB.MAIN_WALLET, cur, res["sold"], res["bought"], res["sell_amt"], res["buy_amt"])
                cur = dict(after)
                res["after_source"] = _src
                total_after = round(sum(MB.usd_map(after, prices).values()), 4)
                MB.append_trade_logs(
                    res["when_pt"], f"{res['sold']}\u2192{res['bought']}", res["sold"], res["sell_amt"],
                    res["bought"], res["buy_amt"], res["fill_rate"], res["pair"], res["signature"], after, total_after,
                    f"DAILY_V2 target {p['target'][res['bought']]:.2f}% {res['bought']}; 1/10 of ${leg['full_usd']:.2f}; "
                    f"{res.get('venue')} local signer wallet", kind=res["kind"])
            except Exception as e:
                res["log_error"] = type(e).__name__
    if not dry_run:
        st["done"] = True
        st["plan"] = {"fng": fng, "target": p["target"], "total_usd": p["total_usd"]}
        _save_state(st)
    return results, ("daily_rebalance_v2 dry-run" if dry_run else "daily_rebalance_v2 ran")


def _dry_run(quotes=True):
    import market_gates as MG
    import morning_balance_run as MB
    import savings_mode
    cb = json.loads((ROOT / "cost-basis.json").read_text())
    f = MG.fetch_fng(MG.cfgs(cb)[0])  # saved daily value; fetches only if the 9 PM refetch is due
    if f.get("value") is None:
        print(json.dumps({"skip": "fear_greed_unavailable", "fng": f})); return 2
    raw, _held = MB.get_balances(MB.MAIN_WALLET)
    bals = savings_mode.trading_balances(cb, {t: float(raw.get(t) or 0) for t in BOOK})
    prices, src = MB.jupiter_prices()
    vol = volume_shares()
    gates = MG.Gates(cb, fng=f, vwap={})  # VWAP never consulted (skip_vwap); no Kraken fetch
    p = plan(cb, bals, prices, f["value"], vol, gates=gates)
    p["fng_detail"], p["price_source"], p["balances"], p["prices"] = f, src, bals, prices
    if quotes:
        res, note = run_morning(cb, bals, prices, dry_run=True, fng=f["value"], vol=vol, gates=gates)
        p["wired_dry_run"] = {"note": note, "results": res}
    print(json.dumps(p, indent=1, default=str))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if "--dry-run" not in sys.argv[1:]:
        print("daily_rebalance_v2: disabled build; only --dry-run is supported", flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(1)
    raise SystemExit(_dry_run(quotes="--no-quotes" not in sys.argv[1:]))

// Serves the static desk from the ASSETS binding with correct types and no caching on data.
const TYPES = {
  ".json": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
  ".jsonl": "application/x-ndjson; charset=utf-8",
  ".md": "text/markdown; charset=utf-8",
  ".html": "text/html; charset=utf-8",
  ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
  ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
  ".png": "image/png",
  ".ico": "image/x-icon",
  ".svg": "image/svg+xml",
  ".webp": "image/webp",
};
const NO_STORE = [".json", ".jsonl", ".md", ".html"];

export default {
  async fetch(request, env) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    if (request.method !== "GET" && request.method !== "HEAD") {
      return new Response("Method not allowed", { status: 405 });
    }
    let path = url.pathname;
    if (path === "/" || path === "") path = "/index.html";
    const assetUrl = new URL(path, url.origin);
    const res = await env.ASSETS.fetch(new Request(assetUrl.toString(), { method: request.method }));
    const headers = new Headers(res.headers);
    const ext = (path.match(/\.[a-z0-9]+$/i) || [""])[0].toLowerCase();
    if (TYPES[ext]) headers.set("content-type", TYPES[ext]);
    if (NO_STORE.includes(ext)) {
      headers.set("cache-control", "no-store, max-age=0");
      headers.delete("etag");
    } else if (res.ok) {
      headers.set("cache-control", "public, max-age=300");
    }
    headers.set("x-content-type-options", "nosniff");
    // sec1014: security headers
    headers.set("content-security-policy", [
      "default-src 'self'",
      "script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://static.cloudflareinsights.com",
      "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'",
      "img-src 'self' data: blob: https:",
      "font-src 'self' data:",
      "connect-src 'self' https://api.coingecko.com https://api.geckoterminal.com https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com https://rpc.ankr.com https://solana-rpc.publicnode.com https://cloudflareinsights.com",
      "object-src 'none'",
      "base-uri 'self'",
      "form-action 'none'",
      "frame-ancestors 'none'",
    ].join("; "));
    headers.set("strict-transport-security", "max-age=31536000");
    headers.set("x-frame-options", "DENY");
    headers.set("referrer-policy", "strict-origin-when-cross-origin");
    headers.set("permissions-policy", "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), interest-cohort=()");
    return new Response(res.body, { status: res.status, headers });
  },
};
