function balOf(bag, name){
  const b=bag&&bag[name];
  return {amount:b?Number(b.amount)||0:0, usd:b?Number(b.usd)||0:0};
}
function rememberPair(x){
  if(!x||!x.from||!x.to) return;
  const row={rev:!!x.rev,from:sym(x.from),to:sym(x.to),fill:!!x.fill,time:x.time||""};
  const prev=knownPairs.get(closestKey(row));
  if(prev&&prev.time&&!row.time) row.time=prev.time;
  if(prev&&prev.fill) row.fill=true;
  knownPairs.set(closestKey(row), row);
}
function footText(){
  const bits=[source];
  if(quoteNote) bits.push(quoteNote);
  if(savNote&&savOn()) bits.push(savNote);
  if(lastItemsHeld) bits.push("closest held");
  { const t=Date.parse(check&&check.time||""); if(Number.isFinite(t)){ const m=Math.round((Date.now()-t)/60000); if(m>=15) bits.push("last check "+(m>=120?Math.round(m/60)+" h":m+" min")+" ago"); } }
  return bits.join(" · ");
}
function parseTrades(text){
  const out=[];
  for (const l of text.split(/\n/)) {
    const s=l.trim();
    if(!s.startsWith("{")) continue;
    try { out.push(JSON.parse(s)); } catch(e) {}
  }
  return out.sort((a,b)=>String(a.time_pt||"").localeCompare(String(b.time_pt||"")));
}
function parseClosest(block){
  const items=[], line=((block.match(/^-\s*closest3:\s*(.+)$/m)||[])[1]||"").trim();
  if(!line || /^n\/?a$/i.test(line) || /^none$/i.test(line)) return items;
  for (const p of line.split(/,\s+(?=(?:REV:)?[A-Za-z0-9]+→)/)) {
    const m=p.trim().match(/^(REV:)?([A-Za-z0-9]+)→([A-Za-z0-9]+).*?(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*%\s*\/\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*%(?:\s+(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)pts)?/);
    if(m) items.push({rev:!!m[1],from:sym(m[2]),to:sym(m[3]),a:Number(m[4]),b:Number(m[5]),c:m[6]!=null?Number(m[6]):null});
  }
  return items;
}
function lastWorkingPairs(){
  const seenK=new Set(), out=[];
  for(let i=rows.length-1;i>=0 && out.length<3;i--){
    const r=rows[i]; if(!r||!r.sold_asset||!r.bought_asset) continue;
    const k=keyOf(r.sold_asset,r.bought_asset);
    if(seenK.has(k)) continue;
    seenK.add(k);
    out.push({rev:false,from:sym(r.sold_asset),to:sym(r.bought_asset),fill:true,time:r.time_pt||""});
  }
  return out;
}
function parseDesk(d){
  const T=SOLSCAN_TX;
  const r=(d.r||[]).map(x=>({time_pt:x[0],sold_asset:x[1],sold_amount:x[2],bought_asset:x[3],bought_amount:x[4],tx_url:x[5]?(/:\/\//.test(x[5])?x[5]:T+x[5]):"",rev:x.length>6?x[6]:undefined}));
  (d.p||[]).forEach(x=>rememberPair({rev:!!x[0],from:x[1],to:x[2]}));
  const c=d.c, bal={};
  if(c&&c.mm!=null) memeOn=!!c.mm;
  if(c&&c.sm!=null) savModeOn=!!c.sm;
  let chk=null;
  if(c){
    for(const k of Object.keys(c.b||{})) bal[sym(k)]={amount:c.b[k][0],usd:c.b[k][1]};
    const it=(c.i||[]).map(x=>({rev:!!x[0],from:sym(x[1]),to:sym(x[2]),a:x[3],b:x[4],c:x.length>5?x[5]:null}));
    it.forEach(rememberPair);
    const sv=c.sv||[];
    chk={time:c.t||"",bt:c.bt||c.t||"",status:c.s||"",addr:c.a||"",bal,total:c.T??null,unrealPct:c.u??null,funded:c.f??null,savings:{jito:sv[0]??null,jitoUsd:sv[1]??null,goat:sv[2]??null,goatUsd:sv[3]??null},bias:c.bi?{least:sym(c.bi[0]),most:sym(c.bi[1])}:null,items:it,itemsTime:c.it||"",itemsHeld:!!c.ih,next:c.nx||""};
  }
  history=(d.h||[]).map(usd=>({usd}));
  const vol={}; for(const k of Object.keys(d.v||{})){ const s=sym(k); if(!vol[s]) vol[s]={sold:0,bought:0}; vol[s].sold+=d.v[k][0]; vol[s].bought+=d.v[k][1]; }
  return {rows:r, check:chk, n:Number.isFinite(d.n)?d.n:r.length, vol, series:Array.isArray(d.cs)?d.cs:null};
}
const SOLSCAN_TX="https://solscan.io/tx/";
function parseLog(md){
  const blocks=md.split(/\n(?=## )/).filter(b=>/total_usd:/.test(b));
  history=blocks.map(b=>{ const tot=b.match(/total_usd:\s*\$([\d.,]+)/); return tot?{usd:Number(tot[1].replace(/,/g,""))}:null; }).filter(Boolean);
  const last=blocks.at(-1)||md, bal={};
  for (const m of ((last.match(/^-\s*balances:\s*(.+)$/m)||[])[1]||"").matchAll(/([A-Za-z]+)=([\d.eE+-]+)\s+\(\$([\d.,]+)\)/g)) bal[sym(m[1])]={amount:Number(m[2]),usd:Number(m[3].replace(/,/g,""))};
  const tot=last.match(/total_usd:\s*\$([\d.,]+)(?:\s+\(unrealized\s+(-?[\d.]+)%\s+vs\s+\$([\d.,]+)\s+funded\))?/);
  const savJ=last.match(/savings_jitosol_held:\s*([\d.eE+-]+)\s+\(\$([\d.,]+)\)/);
  const savG=last.match(/savings_goat_held:\s*([\d.eE+-]+)\s+\(\$([\d.,]+)\)/);
  const bias=last.match(/holdings_bias:\s*least=(\S+)\s+most=(\S+)/);
  let items=parseClosest(last), itemsTime=(last.match(/^##\s+(\S+)/)||[])[1]||"", itemsHeld=false;
  if(!items.length){
    for(let i=blocks.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const found=parseClosest(blocks[i]);
      if(found.length){ items=found; itemsTime=(blocks[i].match(/^##\s+(\S+)/)||[])[1]||itemsTime; itemsHeld=true; break; }
    }
  }
  blocks.forEach(b=>parseClosest(b).forEach(rememberPair));
  return {time:(last.match(/^##\s+(\S+)/)||[])[1]||"",status:(last.match(/Primary edge check\s+[—–-]\s+(\S+)/)||[])[1]||"",addr:(last.match(/`([1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44})`/)||[])[1]||"",bal,total:tot?Number(tot[1].replace(/,/g,"")):null,unrealPct:tot&&tot[2]!=null?Number(tot[2]):null,funded:tot&&tot[3]?Number(tot[3].replace(/,/g,"")):null,savings:{jito:savJ?Number(savJ[1]):null,jitoUsd:savJ?Number(savJ[2].replace(/,/g,"")):null,goat:savG?Number(savG[1]):null,goatUsd:savG?Number(savG[2].replace(/,/g,"")):null},bias:bias?{least:sym(bias[1]),most:sym(bias[2])}:null,items,itemsTime,itemsHeld,next:((last.match(/^-\s*next:\s*(.+)$/m)||[])[1]||"").split("`")[0].trim()};
}
function match(){
  const p=document.getElementById("w-pairs"), tr=document.getElementById("w-trades"), tape=document.getElementById("tape");
  if(!p||!tr||!tape) return;
  if(window.innerWidth<=900){
    tr.style.height="";
    p.style.height="";
    p.style.maxHeight="";
    return;
  }
  const row=tape.querySelector(".fill");
  const rowH=row?row.getBoundingClientRect().height:32;
  tape.style.maxHeight=Math.ceil(rowH*12)+"px";
  tape.style.overflowY="auto";
  const h=tr.getBoundingClientRect().height;
  p.style.minHeight="0";
  p.style.height=h+"px";
  p.style.maxHeight=h+"px";
  p.style.overflowY="hidden";
}
function burst(el){
  if(!el) return;
  const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
  const n = SPARK_COUNT;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const s=document.createElement("i");
    s.className="spark";
    const a=i/n*Math.PI*2;
    s.style.left=(r.left + window.scrollX + r.width/2)+"px";
    s.style.top=(r.top + window.scrollY + r.height/2)+"px";
    s.style.setProperty("--dx",(Math.cos(a)*26)+"px");
    s.style.setProperty("--dy",(Math.sin(a)*26)+"px");
    document.body.appendChild(s);
    setTimeout(()=>s.remove(),1680);
  }
}
function popNumber(el){
  if(!el) return;
  el.classList.remove("pop");
  void el.offsetWidth;
  el.classList.add("pop");
  burst(el);
}
function savingsView(c){
  const s=c.savings||{};
  const jAmt=walletSavings.jito!=null?walletSavings.jito:(s.jito!=null?s.jito:0);
  const gAmt=walletSavings.goat!=null?walletSavings.goat:(s.goat!=null?s.goat:0);
  const jpx=Number(marketData["jito-staked-sol"]?.usd);
  const jUsd=(Number.isFinite(jpx)&&jpx>0&&Number.isFinite(jAmt))?jAmt*jpx:(walletSavings.jitoUsd!=null?walletSavings.jitoUsd:(s.jitoUsd!=null?s.jitoUsd:(jAmt===0?0:null)));
  const gUsd=walletSavings.goatUsd!=null?walletSavings.goatUsd:(s.goatUsd!=null?s.goatUsd:(gAmt===0?0:null));
  const savTotal=(jUsd==null&&gUsd==null)?null:(jUsd||0)+(gUsd||0);
  return {jAmt,gAmt,jUsd,gUsd,savTotal};
}
function chartSeries(){
  let series=(deskSeries||rows.map(r=>r.total_usd_after==null?NaN:Number(r.total_usd_after))).filter(v=>Number.isFinite(v)&&v>0);
  if(series.length<2) series=history.map(p=>p.usd).filter(v=>Number.isFinite(v));
  return series;
}

function donut(cx,cy,r0,r1,a0,a1){
  const large=a1-a0>Math.PI?1:0;
  const x0=cx+Math.cos(a0)*r1, y0=cy+Math.sin(a0)*r1, x1=cx+Math.cos(a1)*r1, y1=cy+Math.sin(a1)*r1;
  const ix1=cx+Math.cos(a1)*r0, iy1=cy+Math.sin(a1)*r0, ix0=cx+Math.cos(a0)*r0, iy0=cy+Math.sin(a0)*r0;
  return `M${x0.toFixed(2)} ${y0.toFixed(2)} A${r1} ${r1} 0 ${large} 1 ${x1.toFixed(2)} ${y1.toFixed(2)} L${ix1.toFixed(2)} ${iy1.toFixed(2)} A${r0} ${r0} 0 ${large} 0 ${ix0.toFixed(2)} ${iy0.toFixed(2)} Z`;
}
function mixOf(bal){
  const usd={}, pct={};
  const parts=ASSETS.map(s=>({s, usd:bal&&bal[s]?Number(bal[s].usd)||0:0}));
  const total=parts.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.usd,0);
  parts.forEach(p=>{ usd[p.s]=p.usd; pct[p.s]=total?p.usd/total:0; });
  return {usd,pct,total};
}
function pieEyeColor(){
  const eye=document.getElementById("spider");
  if(eye&&eye.classList.contains("above")) return "#3dff9a";
  if(eye&&eye.classList.contains("below")) return "#ff6b81";
  return "#f4ffff";
}
function syncPieEyes(){
  const c=pieEyeColor();
  document.querySelectorAll("#pie .pie-eye").forEach(el=>{
    el.setAttribute("fill", c);
    el.setAttribute("stroke", c);
  });
}
// piesav1014: pie slices. Held JitoSOL (JitoSOL price) rides in the SOL slice;
// Greedy Goats gets its own brown slice when over $0.004. Cards/volume unchanged.
function pieParts(bal){
  let sv={jUsd:0,gUsd:0}; try{ sv=savingsView(check||{}); }catch(e){}
  const j=Number(sv.jUsd)>0?Number(sv.jUsd):0, g=Number(sv.gUsd)>0?Number(sv.gUsd):0;
  return ASSETS.map(s=>({s, usd:(bal&&bal[s]?Number(bal[s].usd)||0:0)+(s==="SOL"?j:0)}))
    .concat([{s:"Greedy Goats", usd:g}]).filter(p=>p.usd>0.004);
}
function pieSpider(bal){
  const eye=pieEyeColor();
  const leg=(d,from,to,delay)=>`<g><path d="${d}" fill="none" stroke="url(#legHue)" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="${from};${to};${from}" dur="1.05s" begin="${delay}" repeatCount="indefinite" additive="sum"/></g>`;
  const parts=pieParts(bal);
  const total=parts.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.usd,0);
  const slices=total?parts:ASSETS.map(s=>({s, usd:1}));
  const sum=slices.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.usd,0);
  let a0=-Math.PI/2, wedges="";
  slices.forEach(p=>{
    const a1=a0+p.usd/sum*Math.PI*2, large=a1-a0>Math.PI?1:0;
    const x0=Math.cos(a0)*14, y0=4.2+Math.sin(a0)*14, x1=Math.cos(a1)*14, y1=4.2+Math.sin(a1)*14;
    wedges+=`<path d="M0 4.2 L${x0.toFixed(2)} ${y0.toFixed(2)} A14 14 0 ${large} 1 ${x1.toFixed(2)} ${y1.toFixed(2)} Z" fill="${COLORS[p.s]||"#8d86a8"}"/>`;
    a0=a1;
  });
  return `<g id="pieSpider" filter="url(#pieglow)" transform="translate(80 81) scale(1.15)">
    <defs>
      <linearGradient id="legHue" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9b7bff"/><stop offset="40%" stop-color="#3ee0ff"/><stop offset="72%" stop-color="#f4ffff"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#3dff9a"/></linearGradient>
      <clipPath id="swirlClip"><ellipse cx="0" cy="4.2" rx="7.4" ry="5.6"/></clipPath>
    </defs>
    ${isMobile ? '' : '<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 -0.7;0 0.9;0 -0.7" dur="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" additive="sum"/>'}
    ${leg("M-4 -1 Q-16 -12 -22 -8 Q-18 -2 -8 1","-8","7","0s")}
    ${leg("M-5 1 Q-18 2 -24 8 Q-16 8 -8 3","6","-8",".12s")}
    ${leg("M-4 4 Q-14 12 -18 18 Q-10 12 -6 6","8","-6",".05s")}
    ${leg("M-2 7 Q-8 16 -6 22 Q-2 16 -1 9","-6","8",".18s")}
    ${leg("M4 -1 Q16 -12 22 -8 Q18 -2 8 1","8","-7",".08s")}
    ${leg("M5 1 Q18 2 24 8 Q16 8 8 3","-6","8",".16s")}
    ${leg("M4 4 Q14 12 18 18 Q10 12 6 6","-8","6",".02s")}
    ${leg("M2 7 Q8 16 6 22 Q2 16 1 9","6","-8",".14s")}
    <g clip-path="url(#swirlClip)">
      <g>
        ${isMobile ? '' : '<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 0 4.2" to="360 0 4.2" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>'}
        ${wedges}
      </g>
    </g>
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="4.2" rx="7.4" ry="5.6" fill="none" stroke="#b4f0ff" stroke-width=".55"/>
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="-3.4" rx="6.4" ry="5.1" fill="#123044" stroke="#3ee0ff" stroke-width=".7"/>
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="-4.1" rx="5.1" ry="3.8" fill="#0c2434"/>
    <circle class="pie-eye" cx="-2.3" cy="-4.6" r="1.35" fill="${eye}" stroke="${eye}" stroke-width=".3"/>
    <circle class="pie-eye" cx="2.3" cy="-4.6" r="1.35" fill="${eye}" stroke="${eye}" stroke-width=".3"/>
  </g>`;
}
function drawPie(bal){
  const svg=document.getElementById("pie"), legend=document.getElementById("pieLegend");
  if(!svg||!legend) return;
  const parts=pieParts(bal);
  const total=parts.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.usd,0);
  const shell=`<defs>
    <filter id="pieglow" x="-40%" y="-40%" width="180%" height="180%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="1.5" result="b"/><feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge></filter>
    <radialGradient id="core" cx="50%" cy="42%" r="62%"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1b4d66"/><stop offset="58%" stop-color="#0a121c"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#05070e"/></radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="sweep" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#3ee0ff" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="55%" stop-color="#3ee0ff" stop-opacity=".22"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#9b7bff" stop-opacity="0"/></linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="spiderBody" cx="40%" cy="30%" r="70%"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f4f8fb"/><stop offset="45%" stop-color="#c5d2dc"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5d6b78"/></radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx="80" cy="80" r="77" fill="none" stroke="rgba(62,224,255,.22)" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>${isMobile ? '' : '<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 80 80" to="360 80 80" dur="16s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>'}<circle class="orbit orbit-outer" cx="80" cy="80" r="74.5" fill="none" stroke="rgba(62,224,255,.7)" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="3 8" filter="url(#pieglow)"/></g>
  <g>${isMobile ? '' : '<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="360 80 80" to="0 80 80" dur="24s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>'}<circle class="orbit orbit-mid" cx="80" cy="80" r="70" fill="none" stroke="rgba(155,123,255,.55)" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-dasharray="16 12" filter="url(#pieglow)"/></g>`;
  if(!total){
    svg.innerHTML=shell+`<circle cx="80" cy="80" r="40" fill="url(#core)" stroke="rgba(62,224,255,.45)" stroke-width="1"/>${pieSpider(bal)}`;
    legend.innerHTML="";
    applyIdleRings();
    syncPieEyes();
    return;
  }
  const gap=parts.length>1?0.05:0;
  let a0=-Math.PI/2, paths="", marks="";
  parts.forEach(p=>{
    const ang=p.usd/total*Math.PI*2, a1=a0+ang, s0=a0+gap/2, s1=a1-gap/2;
    if(s1>s0){
      paths+=`<path d="${donut(80,80,46,68,s0,s1)}" fill="${COLORS[p.s]||"#8d86a8"}" opacity=".9" stroke="#f4ffff" stroke-width=".45" filter="url(#pieglow)"/>`;
      paths+=`<path d="${donut(80,80,66,68,s0,s1)}" fill="#f4ffff" opacity=".28"/>`;
    }
    const icon=ICONS[p.s];
    if(icon && ang>0.2){
      const mid=a0+ang/2, rad=57;
      const mx=80+Math.cos(mid)*rad, my=80+Math.sin(mid)*rad;
      marks+=`<g transform="translate(${mx.toFixed(2)} ${my.toFixed(2)})"><g transform="translate(-8 -8) scale(.5)">${icon}</g></g>`;
    }
    a0=a1;
  });
  svg.innerHTML=shell+`<g>${paths}</g>
  <g><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 80 80" to="360 80 80" dur="5.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/><path d="M80 80 L80 8 A72 72 0 0 1 118 28 Z" fill="url(#sweep)"/></g>
  <circle cx="80" cy="80" r="42" fill="url(#core)" stroke="rgba(62,224,255,.7)" stroke-width="1.2" filter="url(#pieglow)"/>
  <g>${isMobile ? '' : '<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 80 80" to="-360 80 80" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>'}<circle class="orbit" cx="80" cy="80" r="34" fill="none" stroke="rgba(61,255,154,.4)" stroke-width=".7" stroke-dasharray="2 4"/></g>
  ${marks}
  ${pieSpider(bal)}`;
  applyIdleRings();
  legend.innerHTML=parts.map(p=>{
    const c=COLORS[p.s]||"#8d86a8";
    return `<span style="color:${c}"><i data-base="${c}" style="background:${c};color:${c}"></i>${esc(p.s)} ${Math.round(p.usd/total*100)}%</span>`;
  }).join("");
  syncPieEyes();
}
function paint(){
  if(ritual||tradeJob||tradeJobs.length){ deferredPaint=true; return; }
  const c=check||{}, bal=c.bal||{}, pnl=c.total!=null&&c.funded!=null?c.total-c.funded:null;
  fullAddr=c.addr||"";
  if(c.items&&c.items.length){ lastItems=c.items; lastItemsTime=c.itemsTime||c.time||""; lastItemsHeld=!!c.itemsHeld; }

  { const st=document.getElementById("stats"); if(st) st.classList.toggle("nosav",!savOn()); }

    setAsset(boughtSym, boughtFrom.amount, boughtFrom.usd);

    if(prevBal) ASSETS.forEach(s=>{ const a=Number(prevBal[s]&&prevBal[s].amount), b=Number(bal[s]&&bal[s].amount); if(Number.isFinite(a)&&Number.isFinite(b)&&b>a*1.000001+1e-9){ const d=(b-a)*(Number(bal[s].usd)/b||1); if(d>ud){ud=d;up=s;} } });

    const sa=Number(r.sold_amount)||0, ba=Number(r.bought_amount)||0;
    if(!vol[sold]) vol[sold]={sold:0,bought:0};
    if(!vol[bought]) vol[bought]={sold:0,bought:0};

  }
  const order=[...ASSETS,...Object.keys(vol).filter(s=>!ASSETS.includes(s))];
  const volHtml=`<div class="vol-count"><div class="k panel-title">TOTAL TRADES</div><b id="tradeCount">${deskN??rows.length}</b><div class="sub">filled legs</div></div><div class="vol-grid">${order.filter(s=>vol[s]).map(s=>{const v=vol[s], turn=v.sold+v.bought; let volLabel=s; if(s==="USD"||s==="SOL"||s==="BTC"||s==="ETH") volLabel=" "+s; if(s==="JitoSOL") volLabel=" Staked SOLANA"; return `<div class="vol-asset" data-asset="${esc(s)}" style="--c:${COLORS[s]||"var(--cyan)"}"><div class="k"><span class="asset-label">${logo(s)}<span>${esc(volLabel)} VOLUME</span></span></div><b>${amt(turn)}</b><div class="sub"><span>sold ${amt(v.sold)}</span><span>bought ${amt(v.bought)}</span></div></div>`;}).join("")}</div>`;

  const fills={}; for(const r of rows) fills[keyOf(r.sold_asset,r.bought_asset)]=r;
  const topKeySet=new Set(top.map(marketKey));
  const when=lastItemsTime?lastItemsTime.slice(5,16).replace("T"," "):"";

    if(x.fill) return `<div class="pair close" data-key="${esc(k)}" data-window="1"><div class="head"><span class="who">${pairWho(x.from,x.to,false)}</span><span>${x.time?esc(x.time.slice(5,16).replace("T"," ")):"last fill"}</span></div></div>`;
    const hasC=closestHasC(x), short=closestShort(x), near=short<=.35;

  const isRevFlags = rows.map(r => hasRevFlag ? !!r.rev : false);

    for (let j = i - 1; j >= start; j--) {
      if (consumed[j]) continue;
      const prev = rows[j];
      if (keyOf(prev.sold_asset, prev.bought_asset) === opp) {

        consumed[j] = true;
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  const tapeRows = rows.slice(-100);
  document.getElementById("tradesTitle").textContent="BALANCE SINCE INCEPTION / "+(tapeRows.length?"LAST "+tapeRows.length+" TRADE"+(tapeRows.length===1?"":"S"):"TRADES");
  const tapeHtml = tapeRows.slice().reverse().map(r => {
    const fullIdx = rows.indexOf(r);
    const isRev = isRevFlags[fullIdx] || false;

    const txPart = href ? `<span class="sep-dot">·</span><a href="${href}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">tx</a>` : "";
    return `<div class="fill"><span>${esc(String(r.time_pt||"").slice(5,16).replace("T"," "))}</span><span class="who">${pairWho(r.sold_asset, r.bought_asset, isRev)}<span class="sep-dot">·</span><span>${esc(qty(r.sold_amount))} → ${esc(qty(r.bought_amount))}</span>${txPart}</span></div>`;
  }).join("");
  document.getElementById("foot").textContent=footText();
  const pairsKey=closestHtml;
  const pieWillAnimate=!!(seen.pie && seen.pie!==pieKey && pendingSig.pie!==pieKey && !newTrade);
  const statsChanged=norm(seen.stats)!==norm(statsHtml) && !newTrade;
  if(!seen.stats){ document.getElementById("stats").innerHTML=statsHtml; seen.stats=statsHtml; drawPie(bal); seen.pie=pieKey; rememberMix(bal); }
  else if(statsChanged && pieWillAnimate){
    pendingStatsForPie=statsHtml;
  }
  else if(statsChanged) noteUpdate("stats", sv.savTotal==null?(c.total==null?"balances":money(c.total)):money(sv.savTotal), ()=>applyBox("stats", statsHtml, "stats"), statsHtml);
  if(pieWillAnimate) noteUpdate("pie", "Pie Charts", ()=>updatePie(bal, pieKey), pieKey);
  else if(!newTrade && seen.pie===pieKey && !pendingSig.pie){ drawPie(bal); rememberMix(bal); }
  if(!seen.volume){ document.getElementById("volume").innerHTML=volHtml; seen.volume=volHtml; }
  else if(norm(seen.volume)!==norm(volHtml) && !newTrade) noteUpdate("volume", (deskN??rows.length)+" trades", ()=>applyBox("volume", volHtml, "volume"), volHtml);
  if(!seen.tape){ document.getElementById("tape").innerHTML=tapeHtml; seen.tape=tapeHtml; }
  else if(seen.tape!==tapeHtml && !newTrade) noteUpdate("w-trades", latest?keyOf(latest.sold_asset,latest.bought_asset):"trade", ()=>applyBox("tape", tapeHtml, "tape"), tapeHtml);
  if(!seen.pairs){ document.getElementById("closest").innerHTML=closestHtml; seen.pairs=pairsKey; }
  else if(newTrade){ pendingClosest=closestHtml; pendingPairsKey=pairsKey; }
  else if(seen.pairs!==pairsKey && pendingSig["w-pairs"]!==pairsKey) noteUpdate("w-pairs", top[0]?(top[0].fill?keyOf(top[0].from,top[0].to):keyOf(top[0].from,top[0].to)+" "+(top[0].a==null&&!closestHasC(top[0])?"":(closestShort(top[0])<=0?"clears":closestShort(top[0]).toFixed(3)+"% short"))):"pairs", ()=>animateClosest(closestHtml, pairsKey), pairsKey);
  if(seen.mode && seen.mode!==statusText) noteUpdate("w-head", statusText, null, statusText);
  seen.mode=statusText;
  if(newTrade){ pendingStats=statsHtml; pendingVol=volHtml; pendingTape=tapeHtml; pendingPie=pieKey; pendingBal=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(bal)); }
  match();
  requestAnimationFrame(match);
}

function applyBox(id, html, key){
  const el=document.getElementById(id);
  if(!el) return;
  el.innerHTML=html;
  seen[key]=html;
  el.querySelectorAll("b").forEach(popNumber);
  match();
}
function withTimeout(ms){ return typeof AbortSignal!=="undefined"&&AbortSignal.timeout?AbortSignal.timeout(ms):undefined; }
async function rpc(method,params){
  let last=new Error("rpc failed");
  for(const url of RPCS){
    try{
      const r=await fetch(url,{method:"POST",headers:{"content-type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({jsonrpc:"2.0",id:1,method,params}),signal:withTimeout(8000)});
      if(!r.ok) throw new Error("rpc "+r.status);
      const data=await r.json();
      if(data.error) throw new Error(data.error.message||"rpc error");
      return data.result;
    }catch(e){ last=e; }
  }
  throw last;
}
async function tokenAmount(owner,mint){
  let total=0, saw=false;
  for(const programId of TOKEN_PROGRAMS){
    const result=await rpc("getTokenAccountsByOwner",[owner,{mint,programId},{encoding:"jsonParsed"}]).catch(()=>null);
    if(!result) continue;
    saw=true;
    const rows=result.value||[];
    total+=rows.reduce((s,a)=>{
      const t=a.account&&a.account.data&&a.account.data.parsed&&a.account.data.parsed.info.tokenAmount;
      return s+Number(t&&(t.uiAmountString||t.uiAmount)||0);
    },0);
    if(rows.length) break;
  }
  if(!saw) throw new Error("rpc blocked");
  return total;
}
async function loadSavings(){
  // public RPCs refuse browser token lookups (403 / "Request blocked"): use the wallet savings the bot logs
  if(!fullAddr || !BROWSER_RPC){ savNote="savings from log"; paint(); return; }
  try{
    const [jito,goat]=await Promise.all([tokenAmount(fullAddr,JITOSOL_MINT),tokenAmount(fullAddr,GOAT_MINT)]);
    walletSavings.jito=jito; walletSavings.goat=goat; walletSavings.err="";
    const jp=marketData["jito-staked-sol"]?.usd, gp=marketData.goat?.usd;
    walletSavings.jitoUsd=jp==null?(jito===0?0:null):jito*jp;
    walletSavings.goatUsd=gp==null?(goat===0?0:null):goat*gp;
    savNote=jp==null||gp==null?"savings live, price pending":"savings live";
    paint();
  }catch(e){
    walletSavings.err=String(e&&e.message||e);
    walletSavings.jito=null; walletSavings.goat=null; walletSavings.jitoUsd=null; walletSavings.goatUsd=null;
    savNote="savings from log";
    paint();
  }
}
function hasVal(n){ return n!=null && Number.isFinite(n) && n>0; }
function hasPrice(n){ return n!=null && Number.isFinite(n) && n>=0; }
function fmtMkt(n, kind, isGoat){
  if(!hasPrice(n)) return "—";
  if(kind==="price"){
    if(isGoat){
      const rounded=Math.round(n*1e6)/1e6;
      return "$"+rounded.toFixed(6);
    }
    return money(n, n<2?4:2);
  }
  if(kind==="mcap"||kind==="vol"){
    if(n>=1e12) return "$"+(n/1e12).toFixed(2)+"T";
    if(n>=1e9) return "$"+(n/1e9).toFixed(2)+"B";
    if(n>=1e6) return "$"+(n/1e6).toFixed(2)+"M";
    if(n>=1e3) return "$"+(n/1e3).toFixed(1)+"K";
    return money(n,0);
  }
  return "—";
}
function getShareData(field){
  const items=SHARE_COINS.map(id=>{
    const d=marketData[id]||{};
    const last=lastKnownMarket[id]||{};
    const v=hasVal(d[field])?d[field]:(hasVal(last[field])?last[field]:0);
    const m=MARKET.find(x=>x.id===id);
    return {id, name:m?m.name:id, color:m?m.color:"#888", value:v, icon:m?m.icon:null};
  });
  const total=items.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.value,0);
  return items.map(i=>({...i, pct:total?i.value/total:0}));
}
function drawSharePie(svgId, shares){
  const svg=document.getElementById(svgId);
  if(!svg) return;
  const total=shares.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.pct,0);
  if(!total){ 
    svg.innerHTML=`<circle cx="50" cy="50" r="42" fill="none" stroke="rgba(62,224,255,.25)" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="38" fill="rgba(6,10,18,.6)" stroke="rgba(62,224,255,.15)" stroke-width="1"/>`; 
    return; 
  }
  let a0=-Math.PI/2, paths="", marks="";
  shares.forEach(s=>{
    if(s.pct<=0) return;
    const a1=a0+s.pct*Math.PI*2;
    const large=a1-a0>Math.PI?1:0;
    const x0=50+Math.cos(a0)*42, y0=50+Math.sin(a0)*42;
    const x1=50+Math.cos(a1)*42, y1=50+Math.sin(a1)*42;
    paths+=`<path d="M50 50 L${x0.toFixed(1)} ${y0.toFixed(1)} A42 42 0 ${large} 1 ${x1.toFixed(1)} ${y1.toFixed(1)} Z" fill="${s.color}" opacity=".92" stroke="#f4ffff" stroke-width=".6" filter="url(#shareGlow)"/>`;
    const ang=s.pct*Math.PI*2;
    if(s.icon && ang>0.55){
      const mid=a0+ang/2, rad=26;
      const mx=50+Math.cos(mid)*rad, my=50+Math.sin(mid)*rad;
      const scale=0.45;
      marks+=`<g transform="translate(${mx.toFixed(1)} ${my.toFixed(1)})"><g transform="translate(-8 -8) scale(${scale})">${s.icon.startsWith("<")?s.icon:""}</g></g>`;
    }
    a0=a1;
  });
  svg.innerHTML=`<defs><filter id="shareGlow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="1.2" result="b"/><feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge></filter></defs>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="46" fill="none" stroke="rgba(62,224,255,.18)" stroke-width="1"/>
  ${paths}
  ${marks}
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="44" fill="none" stroke="rgba(244,255,255,.25)" stroke-width=".5"/>`;
}
function updateSharePies(){
  const mcapShares=getShareData("mcap");
  const volShares=getShareData("vol");
  drawSharePie("mcapShare", mcapShares);
  drawSharePie("volShare", volShares);
  const legend=document.getElementById("shareLegend");
  if(legend){
    legend.innerHTML=mcapShares.map(s=>`<span style="color:${s.color}"><i style="background:${s.color};color:${s.color}"></i>${esc(s.name)}</span>`).join("");
  }
}
function renderMarketCards(){
  const priceCapHtml=MARKET.filter(m=>memeOn||!m.goat).map(m=>{
    const d=marketData[m.id]||{};
    const last=lastKnownMarket[m.id]||{};
    let px=hasPrice(d.usd)&&d.usd>0?d.usd:(hasPrice(last.usd)&&last.usd>0?last.usd:null);
    if(m.goat && !hasPrice(px)) px=hasPrice(d.usd)?d.usd:(hasPrice(last.usd)?last.usd:null);
    if(!hasPrice(px)) return "";
    if(hasPrice(d.usd) && d.usd>0) lastKnownMarket[m.id]={...(lastKnownMarket[m.id]||{}),usd:d.usd};
    const ch=d.ch!=null?d.ch:(last.ch!=null?last.ch:null);
    const chHtml=ch!=null&&Number.isFinite(ch)?`<span class="mkt-chg ${ch>=0?"up":"down"}">${ch>=0?"+":""}${ch.toFixed(2)}%</span>`:"";
    let mc=hasVal(d.mcap)?d.mcap:(hasVal(d.fdv)?d.fdv:null);
    if(!hasVal(mc)) mc=hasVal(last.mcap)?last.mcap:(hasVal(last.fdv)?last.fdv:null);
    if(m.goat && (!hasPrice(px) || px<=0) && hasVal(mc)){
      px = Math.round((mc / GOAT_SUPPLY) * 1e6) / 1e6;
    }
    const mcTxt=hasVal(mc)?fmtMkt(mc,"mcap"):"—";
    if(hasVal(d.mcap)||hasVal(d.fdv)) lastKnownMarket[m.id]={...(lastKnownMarket[m.id]||{}),mcap:d.mcap||last.mcap,fdv:d.fdv||last.fdv};
    const iconHtml=m.goat?"🐐":mark(m.icon);
    const goatCls=m.goat?" goat":"";
    const btcCls=m.id==="bitcoin"?" btc":"";
    return `<div class="pair${goatCls}${btcCls}" data-mkt="${m.id}-pc"><span class="who">${iconHtml}<span style="color:${m.color}">${esc(m.name)}</span></span><span class="sep-dot">·</span><span class="mkt-val">${fmtMkt(px,"price",m.goat)} ${chHtml} / ${mcTxt}</span></div>`;
  }).filter(Boolean).join("");
  const volHtml=MARKET.filter(m=>memeOn||!m.goat).map(m=>{
    const d=marketData[m.id]||{};
    const last=lastKnownMarket[m.id]||{};
    const v=hasVal(d.vol)?d.vol:(hasVal(last.vol)?last.vol:null);
    if(!hasVal(v)) return "";
    if(hasVal(d.vol)) lastKnownMarket[m.id]={...(lastKnownMarket[m.id]||{}),vol:d.vol};
    const iconHtml=m.goat?"🐐":mark(m.icon);
    return `<div class="pair" data-mkt="${m.id}-vol"><span class="who">${iconHtml}<span style="color:${m.color}">${esc(m.name)}</span></span><span class="sep-dot">·</span><span class="mkt-val">${fmtMkt(v,"vol")}</span></div>`;
  }).filter(Boolean).join("");
  const pcEl=document.getElementById("mkt-price-cap");
  const volsEl=document.getElementById("mkt-vols");
  if(!pcEl) return;
  const shareKey=getShareData("mcap").map(s=>s.pct.toFixed(4)).join("|")+"||"+getShareData("vol").map(s=>s.pct.toFixed(4)).join("|");
  const key=priceCapHtml+"||"+volHtml+"||"+shareKey;
  if(key===lastMarketKey) return;
  lastMarketKey=key;
  // c3once 2026-10-15: market prices share the Closest 3 window. They refresh quietly (no spider trip,
  // no gold flash), so that window animates once per check and only when the closest data changed.
  pcEl.innerHTML=priceCapHtml;
  if(volsEl) volsEl.innerHTML=volHtml;
  updateSharePies();
}
async function quotes(){
  let note="";
  try {
    const ids=MARKET.filter(m=>!m.goat).map(m=>m.id).concat(["jito-staked-sol"]).join(",");
    const data=await (await fetch("https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids="+ids+"&vs_currencies=usd&include_market_cap=true&include_24hr_vol=true&include_24hr_change=true",{signal:withTimeout(8000)})).json();
    MARKET.filter(m=>!m.goat).forEach(m=>{
      const p=data[m.id];
      if(!p) return;
      marketData[m.id]={usd:p.usd, mcap:p.usd_market_cap, vol:p.usd_24h_vol, ch:p.usd_24h_change};
      if(!note) note=m.name+" "+money(p.usd);
    });
    const jp0=data["jito-staked-sol"]; // jitopx1014: JitoSOL's own price for the Savings panel
    if(jp0&&Number(jp0.usd)>0) marketData["jito-staked-sol"]={usd:Number(jp0.usd)};
    quoteNote="quotes live";
  } catch(e) { quoteNote="quotes blocked"; }
  try {
    const dex=await (await fetch("https://api.geckoterminal.com/api/v2/networks/solana/pools/"+POOL,{signal:withTimeout(8000)})).json();
    const a=dex.data&&dex.data.attributes;
    let px=a?Number(a.base_token_price_usd):NaN;
    const ch=a&&a.price_change_percentage?Number(a.price_change_percentage.h24):null;
    const vol=a&&a.volume_usd?Number(a.volume_usd.h24):null;
    const fdv=a&&a.fdv_usd?Number(a.fdv_usd):null;
    let mcap=a&&a.market_cap_usd?Number(a.market_cap_usd):null;
    if((!Number.isFinite(px) || px<=0) && Number.isFinite(mcap) && mcap>0){
      px = Math.round((mcap / GOAT_SUPPLY) * 1e6) / 1e6;
    }
    if((!Number.isFinite(px) || px<=0) && Number.isFinite(fdv) && fdv>0){
      px = Math.round((fdv / GOAT_SUPPLY) * 1e6) / 1e6;
    }
    if(Number.isFinite(px) && px>0){
      marketData.goat={usd:px, mcap:Number.isFinite(mcap)&&mcap>0?mcap:null, vol:Number.isFinite(vol)&&vol>0?vol:null, fdv:Number.isFinite(fdv)&&fdv>0?fdv:null, ch};
      lastKnownMarket.goat={...(lastKnownMarket.goat||{}),usd:px};
      note="GOAT $"+px.toFixed(6);
    }
  } catch(e) { if(quoteNote!=="quotes blocked") quoteNote="goat quote blocked"; }
  renderMarketCards();
  applyIdleRings();
  document.getElementById("foot").textContent=footText();
  loadSavings();
}
let loadGen=0;
let fillsFv=null, fillsData=null;
function fillTime(t){ return typeof t==="number"?new Date((t-25200)*1000).toISOString().slice(0,19)+"-07:00":t; }
async function loadFills(fv,bust){
  if(fillsData&&fv&&fv===fillsFv) return fillsData;
  try { const r=await fetch("fills.json"+bust,{cache:"no-store",signal:withTimeout(8000)}); if(r.ok){ const f=await r.json(), L=f.L||{}; fillsData={r:(f.r||[]).map(x=>[fillTime(x[0]),L[x[1]]||x[1],x[2],L[x[3]]||x[3],x[4],x[5],x[6]]),v:f.v||{},cs:f.cs||[]}; fillsFv=fv||null; } } catch(e) {}
  return fillsData;
}
async function loadFiles(){
  const gen=++loadGen;
  const bust="?t="+Date.now();
  let nextRows=rows, nextCheck=check, nextSource=source, nextDesk=null;
  try { const r=await fetch("desk.json"+bust,{cache:"no-store",signal:withTimeout(8000)}); if(r.ok){ const dk=await r.json(); const fl=await loadFills(dk.fv,bust); if(fl){ nextDesk=parseDesk(Object.assign({},dk,fl)); nextRows=nextDesk.rows; if(nextDesk.check) nextCheck=nextDesk.check; nextSource="trades.jsonl + sol-usdc-log.md"; } } } catch(e) {}
  if(gen!==loadGen) return;
  if(nextDesk){ deskN=nextDesk.n; deskVol=nextDesk.vol; deskSeries=nextDesk.series; }
  rows=nextRows;
  if(nextCheck) check=nextCheck;
  source=nextSource;
  // a served desk.json with no check yet (new wallet) shows an empty desk, never the sample numbers
  if(!check){ check=parseLog(nextDesk?"":SAMPLE); if(nextDesk) source="waiting for the first check"; else if(source==="waiting for files") source="sample until files are served"; }
  paint();
  loadSavings();
}
async function take(file){
  const text=await file.text();
  let desk=null; if(/\.json$/i.test(file.name)){ try { const j=JSON.parse(text); if(j&&j.r) desk=parseDesk(j); } catch(e) {} }
  if(desk){ rows=desk.rows; if(desk.check) check=desk.check; deskN=desk.n; deskVol=desk.vol; deskSeries=desk.series; source=file.name; }
  else if(/\.md$/i.test(file.name)||text.includes("closest3:")){check=parseLog(text);source=file.name;}
  else {rows=parseTrades(text);deskN=null;deskVol=null;deskSeries=null;source=file.name;}
  paint();
  loadSavings();
}

let lastWidth = window.innerWidth;
function onResize(){
  const w = window.innerWidth;
  // On mobile, ignore height-only changes (URL bar hide/show)
  if (w <= 900 && Math.abs(w - lastWidth) < 20) return;
  lastWidth = w;
  match();
  if (!busy()) reposition();
}
addEventListener("resize", onResize);

function ptClock(){ // viewer's browser time zone (abbreviation from timeZoneName)
  const parts=new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit",hourCycle:"h23",timeZoneName:"short"}).formatToParts(new Date());
  const get=t=>(parts.find(p=>p.type===t)||{}).value||"";
  let tz=get("timeZoneName");
  try{ // browser's own locale names the zone best (en-GB -> BST, en-US -> MST)
    const z=(new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined,{timeZoneName:"short"}).formatToParts(new Date()).find(p=>p.type==="timeZoneName")||{}).value;
    if(z && (!/^(GMT|UTC)/.test(z) || /^(GMT|UTC)/.test(tz))) tz=z; // keep a real abbreviation over GMT+n
  }catch(e){}
  return get("hour")+":"+get("minute")+":"+get("second")+" "+tz;
}
setInterval(()=>{ document.getElementById("clock").textContent=ptClock(); },1000);
document.getElementById("clock").textContent=ptClock();
const spider=document.getElementById("spider"), web=document.getElementById("web"), crumb=document.getElementById("crumb"), laps=["w-head","stats","volume","w-trades","w-pairs"];
let lap=Math.floor(Math.random()*laps.length), dist=0, edgeU=0, pulling=false, dancing=false, pausing=false, queue=[];
let sx=0, sy=0, srot=0, lastTradeKey="", prevBal=null, ritual=false, tradeJob=null, tradeJobs=[], dir=1, idleShot=0, pairAnim=0, crawling=false;
let lastGoldWindow="", quietApplyDepth=0, piePct={}, pieUsd={};
const pairStrands=[];
const flashUntil=new Map();
const pendingSig={};
let flashWait=0;
function pagePoint(el){
  const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {
    x: r.left + window.scrollX + r.width/2,
    y: r.top + window.scrollY + r.height/2,
    left: r.left + window.scrollX,
    top: r.top + window.scrollY,
    w: r.width,
    h: r.height
  };
}
function busy(){ return pulling||dancing||ritual||pausing||tradeJob||tradeJobs.length; }
function armIdleShot(){
  clearInterval(idleShot);
  idleShot=setInterval(()=>{ if(!busy()&&!queue.length) shoot(null); },15000);
}
function place(x,y,rot){ sx=x; sy=y; srot=rot; spider.style.transform=`translate(${x-21}px,${y-15}px) rotate(${rot}deg)`; }
function pointOn(id,u){
  const el=document.getElementById(id);
  if(!el) return {x:sx,y:sy,rot:srot,per:1,u:0};
  const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(), per=2*(r.width+r.height)||1;
  const uu=u==null?Math.random():u, d=((uu%1)+1)%1*per;
  let x,y,rot;
  if(d<r.width){ x=r.left+d + window.scrollX; y=r.top + window.scrollY; rot=0; }
  else if(d<r.width+r.height){ x=r.right + window.scrollX; y=r.top+(d-r.width) + window.scrollY; rot=90; }
  else if(d<r.width*2+r.height){ x=r.right-(d-r.width-r.height) + window.scrollX; y=r.bottom + window.scrollY; rot=180; }
  else { x=r.left + window.scrollX; y=r.bottom-(d-r.width*2-r.height) + window.scrollY; rot=270; }
  return {x,y,rot,per,u:d/per};
}
function reposition(){
  if(busy()) return;
  const host=laps.includes(laps[lap])?laps[lap]:laps[0];
  const p=pointOn(host, edgeU);
  dist=p.u*p.per; place(p.x,p.y,p.rot);
}
function crawl(){
  if(busy()){ crawling=false; return; }
  crawling=true;
  const host=laps.includes(laps[lap])?laps[lap]:laps[0];
  const r=document.getElementById(host).getBoundingClientRect(), per=2*(r.width+r.height)||1;
  dist+=1.8*dir;
  if(dist>per) dist-=per;
  if(dist<0) dist+=per;
  const p=pointOn(host, dist/per);
  edgeU=p.u;
  place(p.x,p.y,p.rot);
  requestAnimationFrame(crawl);
}
function kickCrawl(){
  crawling=false;
  if(!busy()) requestAnimationFrame(crawl);
}
function isGoldJob(job){
  return !!job && (job.id==="w-tick" || job.id==="pie");
}
function goldWindow(id){
  const el=windowOf(id);
  return (el&&el.id)||id||"";
}
function finishSig(job){
  if(job && job.sig!=null && pendingSig[job.id]===job.sig) delete pendingSig[job.id];
}
function quietApply(job){
  if(!job||!job.apply){ finishSig(job); return; }
  quietApplyDepth++;
  try{
    const done=job.apply();
    if(done&&done.then) done.finally(()=>{ quietApplyDepth=Math.max(0,quietApplyDepth-1); finishSig(job); }).catch(()=>{});
    else { quietApplyDepth=Math.max(0,quietApplyDepth-1); finishSig(job); }
  }catch(e){ quietApplyDepth=Math.max(0,quietApplyDepth-1); finishSig(job); }
}
function noteUpdate(id,label,apply,sig){
  if(sig!=null && pendingSig[id]===sig) return;
  const job={id,label,apply,sig};
  if(sig!=null) pendingSig[id]=sig;
  queue.push(job);
  if(!busy()) shootNext();
}
function shootNext(){
  if(busy()||!queue.length) return;
  while(queue.length){
    const job=queue[0];
    const laterIdx=queue.findIndex((j,i)=>i>0 && j.id===job.id);
    if(laterIdx>0){
      queue.shift();
      finishSig(job);
      continue;
    }
    break;
  }
  if(busy()||!queue.length) return;
  while(queue.length && isGoldJob(queue[0]) && queue[0].id!=="pie" && goldWindow(queue[0].id)===lastGoldWindow) quietApply(queue.shift());
  if(busy()||!queue.length) return;
  shoot(queue.shift());
}
function landOn(next,to){ if(laps.includes(next)){ lap=laps.indexOf(next); dist=to.u*to.per; edgeU=to.u; } }
function windowOf(id){
  const el=document.getElementById(id);
  if(!el) return null;
  return el.closest?el.closest(".panel,header,.ticker")||el:el;
}
function flashRemain(id){
  const el=windowOf(id);
  if(!el) return 0;
  return Math.max(0,(flashUntil.get(el)||0)-performance.now());
}
function flashGold(el){
  if(!el) return;
  flashCounter++;
  if(isMobile && flashCounter % 2 !== 0) return;
  if(el.id) lastGoldWindow=el.id;
  const now=performance.now();
  if((flashUntil.get(el)||0)>now+80) return;
  el.classList.remove("flash-gold","flash-green","flash-red");
  void el.offsetWidth;
  el.classList.add("flash-gold");
  const fms=el.id==="w-pairs"?3000:FLASH_MS;  // gold3: closest-3 window 3 x 1s
  const end=now+fms;
  flashUntil.set(el, end);
  setTimeout(()=>{
    if((flashUntil.get(el)||0)<=performance.now()+40){
      el.classList.remove("flash-gold","flash-green","flash-red");
      flashUntil.delete(el);
    }
  }, fms+50);
}
const FLASH2_MS=2000;  // flash1012: non-trade balance update = exactly 2 gold pulses (1s each)
function flashGold2(el){
  if(!el) return;
  const now=performance.now();
  if((flashUntil.get(el)||0)>now+80) return;
  el.classList.remove("flash-gold","flash-green","flash-red","flash-gold2");
  void el.offsetWidth;
  el.classList.add("flash-gold2");
  flashUntil.set(el, now+FLASH2_MS);
  setTimeout(()=>{
    if((flashUntil.get(el)||0)<=performance.now()+40){ el.classList.remove("flash-gold2"); flashUntil.delete(el); }
  }, FLASH2_MS+50);
}
function flashColored(el, cls){
  if(!el) return;
  flashCounter++;
  if(isMobile && flashCounter % 2 !== 0) return;
  if(el.id) lastGoldWindow=el.id;
  const now=performance.now();
  if((flashUntil.get(el)||0)>now+80) return;
  el.classList.remove("flash-gold","flash-green","flash-red");
  void el.offsetWidth;
  el.classList.add(cls);
  const end=now+COLOR_FLASH_MS;
  flashUntil.set(el, end);
  setTimeout(()=>{
    if((flashUntil.get(el)||0)<=performance.now()+40){
      el.classList.remove("flash-gold","flash-green","flash-red");
      flashUntil.delete(el);
    }
  }, COLOR_FLASH_MS+50);
}
function holdForFlash(job){
  const remain=flashRemain(job.id);
  if(remain<40) return false;
  if(isGoldJob(job) && job.id!=="pie" && goldWindow(job.id)===lastGoldWindow){
    quietApply(job);
    setTimeout(()=>{ if(!busy()) shootNext(); }, 0);
    return true;
  }
  queue.unshift(job);
  clearTimeout(flashWait);
  kickCrawl();
  flashWait=setTimeout(()=>{ if(tradeJobs.length) runTrade(); else shootNext(); }, remain+60);
  return true;
}
function nextShotWait(){
  if(!queue.length) return 700;
  const job=queue[0];
  const remain=job?flashRemain(job.id):0;
  return Math.max(GOLD_GAP, remain>40?remain+60:0);
}
function releaseWeb(){ web.hidden=true; web.classList.remove("gold"); crumb.hidden=true; crumb.classList.remove("gold"); pulling=false; }
function resume(){
  if(deferredPaint && !ritual && !tradeJob && !tradeJobs.length){ deferredPaint=false; paint(); return; }
  kickCrawl();
  shootNext();
}
function afterShot(job){
  finishSig(job);
  if(tradeJobs.length) runTrade();
  else if(job){ shootNext(); if(!pulling&&!pausing) kickCrawl(); }
  else resume();
}
let danceStop=null;
function dancePromise(ms){
  return new Promise(resolve=>{
    dancing=true; spider.classList.add("dance");
    let stopped=false;
    const bx=sx, by=sy, br=srot, t0=performance.now();
    danceStop=()=>{
      if(stopped) return;
      stopped=true;
      dancing=false;
      spider.classList.remove("dance");
      place(bx,by,br);
      resolve();
    };
    (function step(now){
      try{
        if(stopped) return;
        const e=now-t0;
        if(e>=ms){ danceStop(); return; }
        place(bx+Math.cos(e/260)*5, by+Math.sin(e/220)*3.5, br+Math.sin(e/380)*16);
        requestAnimationFrame(step);
      }catch(err){ danceStop(); }
    })(t0);
  });
}
function shoot(job){
  if(dancing||ritual||pausing){ if(job) queue.unshift(job); return; }
  if(job && holdForFlash(job)) return;
  if(job && job.id==="pie"){
    armIdleShot();
    pausing=true;
    let done=null;
    try{ done=job.apply&&job.apply(); }catch(e){ done=null; }
    const finish=()=>{ pausing=false; match(); afterShot(job); };
    if(done&&done.then) done.then(finish, finish);
    else finish();
    return;
  }
  const next=job?job.id:laps[(lap+1+Math.floor(Math.random()*3))%laps.length];
  const label=job?job.label:"";
  const gold=next==="w-tick"||next==="pie"||!!(label&&/\d/.test(label));
  armIdleShot();
  const hereId=laps.includes(laps[lap])?laps[lap]:laps[0];
  const here=document.getElementById(hereId);
  if(!here||!document.getElementById(next)){ if(job&&job.apply) job.apply(); finishSig(job); return; }
  const from={x:sx,y:sy};
  const to=pointOn(next);
  const dx=to.x-from.x, dy=to.y-from.y, len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
  const stay=!laps.includes(next);
  pulling=true; web.hidden=false; web.classList.toggle("gold", gold); web.style.left=from.x+"px"; web.style.top=from.y+"px"; web.style.width=len+"px"; web.style.transform=`rotate(${Math.atan2(dy,dx)}rad)`;
  if(label){ crumb.hidden=false; crumb.textContent=label; crumb.classList.toggle("gold", gold); crumb.style.left=(from.x+8)+"px"; crumb.style.top=(from.y-18)+"px"; }
  const t0=performance.now();
  (function pull(now){
    try{
      const k=Math.min(1,(now-t0)/WEB_MS);
      const x=from.x+dx*k, y=from.y+dy*k;
      if(!stay) place(x,y,to.rot);
      web.style.width=(len*(1-k))+"px"; web.style.left=x+"px"; web.style.top=y+"px";
      if(label){ crumb.style.left=((stay?from.x:x)+8)+"px"; crumb.style.top=((stay?from.y:y)-18)+"px"; }
      if(k<1){ requestAnimationFrame(pull); return; }
      releaseWeb();
      if(!stay) landOn(next,to);
      const el=document.getElementById(next);
      const boxEl=el&&el.closest?el.closest(".panel,header,.ticker")||el:el;
      const done=job&&job.apply&&job.apply();
      if(gold) flashGold(boxEl); else if(boxEl&&job&&job.id==="stats") flashGold2(boxEl); else if(boxEl&&job){ boxEl.classList.add("flash"); setTimeout(()=>boxEl.classList.remove("flash"),700); }  /* c3once: idle trips never flash a window */
      if(done&&done.then){
        pausing=true;
        done.then(()=>{ pausing=false; match(); afterShot(job); },()=>{ pausing=false; match(); afterShot(job); });
        return;
      }
      if(gold&&!stay){
        const wait=nextShotWait();
        kickCrawl();
        setTimeout(()=>{ afterShot(job); }, wait);
      } else afterShot(job);
    }catch(err){ releaseWeb(); afterShot(job); }
  })(t0);
}
function setAsset(name, amount, usd){
  const root=document.querySelector('#stats .asset[data-asset="'+name+'"]');
  if(!root) return;
  const b=root.querySelector("b"), sub=root.querySelector(".sub");
  if(b) b.textContent=money(usd);
  if(sub) sub.textContent=amount;
}
function walkTo(x,y,ms){
  return new Promise(resolve=>{
    const x0=sx, y0=sy, t0=performance.now();
    const rot=Math.atan2(y-y0, x-x0)*180/Math.PI;
    (function step(now){
      const k=Math.min(1,(now-t0)/ms), e=1-Math.pow(1-k,3);
      place(x0+(x-x0)*e, y0+(y-y0)*e, rot);
      if(k<1) requestAnimationFrame(step); else resolve();
    })(t0);
  });
}
function pullTo(x,y,ms){
  armIdleShot();
  return new Promise(resolve=>{
    const x0=sx, y0=sy, dx=x-x0, dy=y-y0, len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
    const rot=Math.atan2(dy,dx)*180/Math.PI;
    pulling=true; web.hidden=false; web.classList.add("gold");
    web.style.left=x0+"px"; web.style.top=y0+"px"; web.style.width=len+"px"; web.style.transform=`rotate(${Math.atan2(dy,dx)}rad)`;
    const t0=performance.now();
    (function step(now){
      try{
        const k=Math.min(1,(now-t0)/ms), e=1-Math.pow(1-k,3);
        const px=x0+dx*e, py=y0+dy*e;
        place(px, py, rot);
        web.style.width=(len*(1-e))+"px"; web.style.left=px+"px"; web.style.top=py+"px";
        if(k<1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
        else { web.hidden=true; web.classList.remove("gold"); pulling=false; resolve(); }
      }catch(err){ releaseWeb(); resolve(); }
    })(t0);
  });
}
function showWeb(x1,y1,x2,y2){
  armIdleShot();
  const dx=x2-x1, dy=y2-y1, len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
  web.hidden=false; web.classList.add("gold");
  web.style.left=x1+"px"; web.style.top=y1+"px"; web.style.width=len+"px"; web.style.transform=`rotate(${Math.atan2(dy,dx)}rad)`;
}
function hideWeb(){ web.hidden=true; web.classList.remove("gold"); }
function clearStrands(){ while(pairStrands.length){ const el=pairStrands.pop(); if(el&&el.remove) el.remove(); } }
function shootStrand(x1,y1,x2,y2){
  const el=document.createElement("div");
  el.className="web gold strand";
  document.body.appendChild(el);
  pairStrands.push(el);
  const t0=performance.now(), dur=520;
  return new Promise(resolve=>{
    (function step(now){
      const k=Math.min(1,(now-t0)/dur), e=1-Math.pow(1-k,3);
      const ax=sx+(x1-sx)*e, ay=sy+(y1-sy)*e;
      const bx=sx+(x2-sx)*e, by=sy+(y2-sy)*e;
      const dx=bx-ax, dy=by-ay, len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
      el.style.left=ax+"px"; el.style.top=ay+"px"; el.style.width=len+"px"; el.style.transform=`rotate(${Math.atan2(dy,dx)}rad)`;
      if(k<1) requestAnimationFrame(step); else resolve(el);
    })(t0);
  });
}
function bridge(x1,y1,x2,y2){ return shootStrand(x1,y1,x2,y2); }
function ride(token, x1, y1, x2, y2, ms, count, gap){
  const icon=ICONS[sym(token)];
  if(!icon) return {start:Promise.resolve(), done:Promise.resolve()};
  const n=count==null?LOGO_COUNT:count, g=gap==null?LOGO_GAP:gap;
  let markStarted=()=>{};
  const start=new Promise(resolve=>{ markStarted=resolve; });
  const launch=(delay,isFirst)=>new Promise(resolve=>{
    setTimeout(()=>{
      const ghost=document.createElement("div");
      ghost.className="logo-slide";
      ghost.style.left=(x1-11)+"px";
      ghost.style.top=(y1-11)+"px";
      ghost.style.transition="none";
      ghost.style.transform="translate(0,0)";
      ghost.innerHTML="<svg viewBox='0 0 32 32'>"+icon+"</svg>";
      document.body.appendChild(ghost);
      requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
        ghost.style.transition=`transform ${ms}ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`;
        ghost.style.transform=`translate(${x2-x1}px,${y2-y1}px)`;
        if(isFirst) markStarted();
      }));
      setTimeout(()=>{ ghost.remove(); resolve(); }, ms+40);
    }, delay);
  });
  const done=Promise.all(Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>launch(i*g,i===0)));
  return {start,done};
}
function rememberMix(bal){
  const mix=mixOf(bal);
  piePct=mix.pct; pieUsd=mix.usd;
}
function tokenPoint(name){
  const box=document.querySelector('#stats .asset[data-asset="'+name+'"]');
  if(!box) return null;
  const token=box.querySelector("svg.mark")||box;
  return pagePoint(token);
}
function topGainer(prevPct, nextPct){
  let best=null, bestD=0;
  ASSETS.forEach(s=>{
    const d=(nextPct[s]||0)-(prevPct[s]||0);
    if(d>bestD){ bestD=d; best=s; }
  });
  return best;
}

function best24Color(){
  // main coins only (owner 2026-10-14): SOL, USDC (stable = 0%), cbBTC, WETH; no GOAT / JitoSOL
  const cands=[["SOL","solana"],["BTC","bitcoin"],["ETH","ethereum"]];
  let best=null, bc=-Infinity, any=false;
  cands.forEach(([s,id])=>{ const r=(marketData[id]||{}).ch, c=(r==null||r==="")?NaN:Number(r); if(Number.isFinite(c)){ any=true; if(c>bc){bc=c;best=s;} } });
  if(any && 0>bc) best="USD";
  return best?COLORS[best]:null;
}

  if(m) document.querySelectorAll("#pie .orbit-mid").forEach(el=>el.setAttribute("stroke", m));
}

function streamAllocation(prevPct, nextPct, prevUsd, nextUsd){
  const pie=document.getElementById("pie");
  if(!pie) return {start:Promise.resolve(), done:Promise.resolve()};
  const center=pagePoint(pie);
  const names=new Set([...ASSETS, ...Object.keys(prevUsd||{}), ...Object.keys(nextUsd||{})]);
  const rides=[];
  names.forEach(name=>{
    if(!ICONS[sym(name)]) return;
    const pt=tokenPoint(name);
    if(!pt) return;
    const d=(nextUsd[name]||0)-(prevUsd[name]||0);
    if(Math.abs(d)<0.01) return;
    if(d>0) rides.push(ride(name, center.x, center.y, pt.x, pt.y, PIE_LOGO_TRAVEL, PIE_LOGO_COUNT, PIE_LOGO_GAP));
    else rides.push(ride(name, pt.x, pt.y, center.x, center.y, PIE_LOGO_TRAVEL, PIE_LOGO_COUNT, PIE_LOGO_GAP));
  });
  if(!rides.length) return {start:Promise.resolve(), done:Promise.resolve()};
  return {
    start: Promise.all(rides.map(r=>r.start)),
    done:  Promise.all(rides.map(r=>r.done))
  };
}
function tweenAsset(name, from, to, ms){
  const t0=performance.now();
  return new Promise(resolve=>{
    (function step(now){
      const k=Math.min(1,(now-t0)/ms);
      setAsset(name, from.amount+(to.amount-from.amount)*k, from.usd+(to.usd-from.usd)*k);
      if(k<1) requestAnimationFrame(step); else { const n=document.querySelector('#stats .asset[data-asset="'+name+'"] b'); popNumber(n); resolve(); }
    })(t0);
  });
}

  if(!ritual&&!pulling&&!dancing&&!pausing&&!tradeJob) runTrade();
}

function pairNodes(){ return [...document.querySelectorAll("#closest .pair")]; }
function pairAttachPoints(p){
  const jiggle=(seed)=>((seed*17)%11-5);
  return [
    {x:p.x + p.w*0.18 + jiggle(1), y:p.cy + jiggle(2)},
    {x:p.cx + jiggle(3), y:p.cy + jiggle(4)},
    {x:p.x + p.w*0.82 + jiggle(5), y:p.cy + jiggle(6)}
  ];
}
function throwOffParallel(prevs){
  if(!prevs.length) return Promise.resolve();
  const ghosts=[];
  const strandPromises=[];
  const sideX = window.innerWidth - 6 + window.scrollX;
  prevs.forEach((prev)=>{
    const ghost=document.createElement("div");
    ghost.className="logo-ghost";
    ghost.style.left=prev.x+"px";
    ghost.style.top=prev.y+"px";
    ghost.style.width=prev.w+"px";
    ghost.style.height=prev.h+"px";
    ghost.innerHTML=prev.html;
    document.body.appendChild(ghost);
    ghosts.push({ghost, prev});
    const pts=[
      {x:prev.x + prev.w*0.85, y:prev.cy},
      {x:prev.x + prev.w*0.5, y:prev.cy - 4},
      {x:prev.x + prev.w*0.5, y:prev.cy + 4}
    ];
    pts.forEach((pt, i)=>{
      const targetX = sideX;
      const targetY = prev.cy + (i-1)*6;
      strandPromises.push(shootStrand(pt.x, pt.y, targetX, targetY));
    });
  });
  return Promise.all(strandPromises).then(()=>new Promise(resolve=>{
    setTimeout(()=>{
      ghosts.forEach(({ghost, prev})=>{
        const dx = (sideX + 40) - prev.x;
        const dy = -20;
        requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
          ghost.style.transition="transform .65s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)";
          ghost.style.transform=`translate(${dx}px,${dy}px)`;
        }));
      });
      clearStrands();
      setTimeout(()=>{
        ghosts.forEach(({ghost})=>ghost.remove());
        resolve();
      }, 720);
    }, 380);
  }));
}
function animateClosest(closestHtml, pairsKey){
  if(seen.pairs===pairsKey) return;
  const gen=++pairAnim;
  const oldPos=new Map();
  pairNodes().forEach(el=>{
    const p=pagePoint(el);
    oldPos.set(el.dataset.key,{x:p.left,y:p.top,cx:p.x,cy:p.y,w:p.w,h:p.h,html:el.outerHTML,window:el.dataset.window==="1"});
  });
  document.getElementById("closest").innerHTML=closestHtml;
  seen.pairs=pairsKey;
  match();
  const newEls=pairNodes();
  const added=newEls.filter(el=>!oldPos.has(el.dataset.key));
  const fell=[...oldPos.entries()].filter(([k,p])=>p.window&&!newEls.some(el=>el.dataset.key===k&&el.dataset.window==="1")).map(([,p])=>p);
  const movers=newEls.filter(el=>{
    const prev=oldPos.get(el.dataset.key);
    if(!prev) return false;
    if(fell.some(p=>p.html===prev.html)&&el.dataset.window!=="1") return false;
    const now=pagePoint(el);
    return Math.abs(now.top-prev.y)>2 || Math.abs(now.left-prev.x)>2;
  });
  added.forEach(el=>{ el.style.opacity="0"; });
  if(!movers.length&&!fell.length){ added.forEach(el=>{ el.style.opacity=""; }); return; }
  return (async()=>{
    if(gen!==pairAnim) return;
    clearStrands();
    if(fell.length) await throwOffParallel(fell);
    added.forEach(el=>{ if(el.isConnected) el.style.opacity=""; });
    const pts=movers.map(el=>{
      const prev=oldPos.get(el.dataset.key);
      return prev?{el,prev}:null;
    }).filter(Boolean).sort((a,b)=>a.prev.cy-b.prev.cy);
    if(pts.length>1){
      const connections=[];
      for(let i=0;i<pts.length;i++){
        for(let j=i+1;j<pts.length;j++){
          if(j-i===1 || (pts.length>2 && Math.abs(j-i)<=2)){
            const aPts=pairAttachPoints(pts[i].prev);
            const bPts=pairAttachPoints(pts[j].prev);
            for(let k=0;k<3;k++){
              connections.push([aPts[k], bPts[(k+1)%3]]);
              if(k===1) connections.push([aPts[k], bPts[k]]);
            }
          }
        }
      }
      await Promise.all(connections.map(([a,b])=>shootStrand(a.x, a.y, b.x, b.y)));
    }
    const flights=pts.filter(p=>p.el.isConnected).map(p=>{
      const prev=p.prev, el=p.el, now=pagePoint(el);
      const ghost=document.createElement("div");
      ghost.className="logo-ghost";
      ghost.style.left=prev.x+"px";
      ghost.style.top=prev.y+"px";
      ghost.style.width=prev.w+"px";
      ghost.style.height=prev.h+"px";
      ghost.innerHTML=prev.html;
      document.body.appendChild(ghost);
      el.style.opacity="0.25";
      return new Promise(resolve=>{
        requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
          ghost.style.transition="transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)";
          ghost.style.transform=`translate(${now.left-prev.x}px,${now.top-prev.y}px)`;
        }));
        setTimeout(()=>{ ghost.remove(); if(el.isConnected) el.style.opacity=""; resolve(); }, 760);
      });
    });
    await Promise.all(flights);
    clearStrands();
    hideWeb();
    match();
  })();
}

  for(let i=queue.length-1;i>=0;i--){ if(queue[i] && queue[i].id==="stats") queue.splice(i,1); }

}
async function updatePie(bal, key, opts){
  const skipStream=!!(opts&&opts.skipStream);
  const prevPct={...piePct}, prevUsd={...pieUsd};
  const next=mixOf(bal);
  const moved=ASSETS.some(s=>Math.abs((next.usd[s]||0)-(prevUsd[s]||0))>0.01);
  const pie=document.getElementById("pie");
  const statsEl=document.getElementById("stats");

  if(!moved || skipStream){
    if(pendingStatsForPie){
      applyBox("stats", pendingStatsForPie, "stats"); flashGold2(document.getElementById("stats"));
      pendingStatsForPie="";
      dropQueuedStats();
    }
    drawPie(bal);
    seen.pie=key||seen.pie;
    piePct=next.pct; pieUsd=next.usd;
    if(skipStream){ drawPie(bal); syncPieEyes(); }
    return;
  }

  // noweb 2026-10-14: no opening web shot at the pie spider; the sequence starts directly

  // nodance 2026-10-14: balance update skips the spider dance and the 180 ms lead-in; the throw starts right away
  const dance = Promise.resolve();

  const stream = streamAllocation(prevPct, next.pct, prevUsd, next.usd);

  await stream.start;
  if(pendingStatsForPie){
    applyBox("stats", pendingStatsForPie, "stats"); flashGold2(document.getElementById("stats"));
    pendingStatsForPie="";
    dropQueuedStats();
  }
  drawPie(bal);
  seen.pie=key||seen.pie;
  piePct=next.pct; pieUsd=next.usd;

  const gainer=topGainer(prevPct, next.pct);
  if(gainer&&COLORS[gainer]){ pieTinting=true; tintPieDots(COLORS[gainer]); }

  try { await Promise.all([stream.done, dance]); } finally { pieTinting=false; }

  drawPie(bal);
  syncPieEyes();
}
function armCurve(x1,y1,x2,y2,k){
  const mx=(x1+x2)/2, my=(y1+y2)/2-Math.min(90, Math.hypot(x2-x1,y2-y1)*0.28);
  const ex=x1+(x2-x1)*k, ey=y1+(y2-y1)*k;
  const cx=x1+(mx-x1)*k, cy=y1+(my-y1)*k;
  return `M${x1} ${y1} Q${cx} ${cy} ${ex} ${ey}`;
}
function reachArm(x1,y1,x2,y2,ms){
  const path=document.getElementById("reachPath");
  return new Promise(resolve=>{
    const t0=performance.now();
    (function step(now){
      const k=Math.min(1,(now-t0)/ms), e=1-Math.pow(1-k,3);
      path.setAttribute("d", armCurve(x1,y1,x2,y2,e));
      if(k<1) requestAnimationFrame(step); else resolve();
    })(t0);
  });
}
function retractArm(ms){
  const path=document.getElementById("reachPath");
  return new Promise(resolve=>{
    const t0=performance.now();
    (function step(now){
      const k=Math.min(1,(now-t0)/ms);
      path.style.opacity=String(1-k);
      if(k<1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
      else { path.setAttribute("d",""); path.style.opacity=""; resolve(); }
    })(t0);
  });
}
async function unveilTape(html){

  match();
  const row=tape.querySelector(".fill");
  if(!row||!pie) return;
  row.classList.add("veiled");
  const from=pagePoint(pie), to=pagePoint(row);
  await reachArm(from.x, from.y, to.x, to.y, 720);
  row.classList.remove("veiled");
  row.classList.add("unveiled");
  burst(row);
  await retractArm(280);
}

      }
    }

    else flashGold(statsBox);

    const slideMs=(LOGO_COUNT-1)*LOGO_GAP+LOGO_TRAVEL;
    if(soldLogo&&boughtLogo){
      const a=pagePoint(soldLogo), b=pagePoint(boughtLogo);

      tweenAsset(job.sold, job.soldFrom, job.soldTo, slideMs);

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Publish the bot-desk dashboard to the Cloudflare Worker `degen-dashboard`.

Serves https://your-dashboard.example.com via a Workers route (no tunnel needed; HTTPS only).
Stages dashboard files into dashboard-worker/public/, hashes them, and runs
`wrangler deploy` only when something changed. Quiet; one log line per deploy or
error in runner-logs/dashboard-publish.log. Never prints the API token.
Safe to call after every runner check: non-locking for trading, exits fast if
another publish is running, hard timeout on the deploy.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import degen_home as _DH  # portable base dir (pcmove 2026-10-10)

import base64

import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

from pathlib import Path
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from degen_home import TZ_NAME as _TZ_NAME

ROOT = Path(_DH.HOME_STR)
DASH = ROOT / "dashboard"
WORKER_DIR = ROOT / "dashboard-worker"
PUBLIC = WORKER_DIR / "public"
STATE = ROOT / "dashboard-publish-state.json"
LOCK = ROOT / "dashboard-publish.lock"
LOG = ROOT / "runner-logs" / "dashboard-publish.log"
WRANGLER_LOGS = ROOT / "runner-logs" / "wrangler"
WRANGLER = "wrangler"  # legacy; REST upload is used now (pcmove 2026-10-10)
CF_API = "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4"

def iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(PT).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat()


def log(msg: str) -> None:
    try:
        LOG.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if LOG.exists() and LOG.stat().st_size > LOG_MAX_BYTES:
            tail = LOG.read_bytes()[-LOG_MAX_BYTES // 2:]
            LOG.write_bytes(tail)
        with LOG.open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
            f.write(f"{iso()} {msg}\n")
    except Exception:
        pass


def token() -> str:
    """CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN from secrets.json (PC) or the box-secrets card; env fallback."""
    return (_DH.get_secret("CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN") or "").strip()


def account_id() -> str:
    v = _DH.get_secret("CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID")
    if v:
        return v
    for ln in (WORKER_DIR / "wrangler.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if ln.strip().startswith("account_id"):
            return ln.split("=", 1)[1].strip().strip('"')
    raise RuntimeError("no account id")


def _req(method, url, tok, body=None, ctype=None, timeout=60):
    hdr = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {tok}", "User-Agent": "degen-publish/1"}
    if ctype:
        hdr["Content-Type"] = ctype
    r = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method=method, headers=hdr)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=timeout) as resp:
            return resp.status, json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8") or "{}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        try:
            data = json.loads(e.read().decode("utf-8") or "{}")
        except Exception:
            data = {}
        return e.code, data


def _multipart(parts):
    """parts: list of (name, filename|None, content_type, bytes)."""
    b = "----degen" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    out = bytearray()
    for name, fname, ct, data in parts:
        out += f"--{b}\r\n".encode()
        disp = f'form-data; name="{name}"' + (f'; filename="{fname}"' if fname else "")
        out += f"Content-Disposition: {disp}\r\nContent-Type: {ct}\r\n\r\n".encode()
        out += data + b"\r\n"
    out += f"--{b}--\r\n".encode()
    return bytes(out), f"multipart/form-data; boundary={b}"


def _errs(data) -> str:
    try:
        return ";".join(f"{e.get('code')}:{str(e.get('message'))[:120]}" for e in (data.get("errors") or []))
    except Exception:
        return "?"


def deploy_rest(tok: str) -> None:
    """Workers static-assets direct upload + script PUT (same result as `wrangler deploy`).

    Routes (your-dashboard.example.com/*) are kept; they are not part of the script upload.
    """
    acct = account_id()
    base = f"{CF_API}/accounts/{acct}/workers"
    files = {}
    for f in sorted(PUBLIC.rglob("*")):
        if not f.is_file() or f.name.startswith("."):
            continue
        data = f.read_bytes()
        b64 = base64.b64encode(data).decode()
        h = hashlib.sha256((b64 + f.suffix.lstrip(".")).encode()).hexdigest()[:32]
        files["/" + f.relative_to(PUBLIC).as_posix()] = (h, len(data), b64, f.suffix)
    manifest = {k: {"hash": v[0], "size": v[1]} for k, v in files.items()}
    st, data = _req("POST", f"{base}/scripts/{SCRIPT_NAME}/assets-upload-session", tok,
                    json.dumps({"manifest": manifest}).encode(), "application/json")
    if st != 200 or not data.get("success"):
        raise RuntimeError(f"upload_session http={st} {_errs(data)}")
    res = data.get("result") or {}
    jwt = res.get("jwt")
    by_hash = {v[0]: v for v in files.values()}
    buckets = res.get("buckets") or []
    sent = sum(by_hash[hh][1] for b in buckets for hh in b)
    global LAST_UPLOAD
    LAST_UPLOAD = (sum(len(b) for b in buckets), sent)
    for bucket in buckets:  # Cloudflare lists only hashes it does not already have
        parts = [(hh, hh, "application/null", by_hash[hh][2].encode()) for hh in bucket]
        body, ct = _multipart(parts)
        st, d2 = _req("POST", f"{base}/assets/upload?base64=true", jwt, body, ct, timeout=120)
        if st not in (200, 201, 202) or d2.get("success") is False:
            raise RuntimeError(f"assets_upload http={st} {_errs(d2)}")
        jwt = (d2.get("result") or {}).get("jwt") or jwt
    meta = {
        "main_module": "index.js",
        "compatibility_date": "2025-03-01",
        "assets": {"jwt": jwt, "config": {"html_handling": "none", "not_found_handling": "none", "run_worker_first": True}},
        "bindings": [{"type": "assets", "name": "ASSETS"}],
    }
    js = (WORKER_DIR / "src" / "index.js").read_bytes()
    body, ct = _multipart([
        ("metadata", None, "application/json", json.dumps(meta).encode()),
        ("index.js", "index.js", "application/javascript+module", js),
    ])
    st, d3 = _req("PUT", f"{base}/scripts/{SCRIPT_NAME}", tok, body, ct, timeout=120)
    if st != 200 or not d3.get("success"):
        raise RuntimeError(f"script_put http={st} {_errs(d3)}")
    # template: trading never runs on Cloudflare; clear any cron triggers on this Worker.
    try:
        _req("PUT", f"{base}/scripts/{SCRIPT_NAME}/schedules", tok, b"[]", "application/json")
    except Exception:
        pass
    # template: make sure the free workers.dev hostname is on, and log it once.
    try:
        _req("POST", f"{base}/scripts/{SCRIPT_NAME}/subdomain", tok,
             json.dumps({"enabled": True, "previews_enabled": False}).encode(), "application/json")
        st4, d4 = _req("GET", f"{CF_API}/accounts/{acct}/workers/subdomain", tok)
        sub = ((d4 or {}).get("result") or {}).get("subdomain")
        if sub:
            log(f"PUBLISH_URL https://{SCRIPT_NAME}.{sub}.workers.dev/")
    except Exception:
        pass


def scrub(text: str, secret: str) -> str:
    if secret:
        text = text.replace(secret, "[token_redacted]")
    return text


def stage() -> dict[str, str]:
    """Copy sources into PUBLIC atomically per file; return name->sha256."""
    PUBLIC.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    hashes: dict[str, str] = {}
    for name, src in FILES.items():
        if not src.exists():  # template: optional images may be absent
            continue
        data = src.resolve().read_bytes()
        dst = PUBLIC / name
        tmp = dst.with_name(f".{name}.tmp")
        tmp.write_bytes(data)
        tmp.replace(dst)
        hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    # template: shared mode flag both sides check before trading (degen_home.remote_run_side)
    mdata = json.dumps({"run_side": _DH.run_side(), "set_by": _DH.THIS_SIDE, "paused": _DH.PAUSE_FILE.exists()}).encode()
    (PUBLIC / "mode.json").write_bytes(mdata)
    hashes["mode.json"] = hashlib.sha256(mdata).hexdigest()
    # logdiet 2026-10-11: desk.json (small, every poll) + fills.json (fetched when fv changes)
    dk, fl = desk_json.split(desk_json.build())
    for nm, obj in ((DESK_NAME, dk), (desk_json.FILLS_NAME, fl)):
        data = desk_json.dumps(obj)
        dst = PUBLIC / nm
        tmp = dst.with_name(f".{nm}.tmp")
        tmp.write_bytes(data)
        tmp.replace(dst)
        hashes[nm] = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    for extra in PUBLIC.iterdir():  # never ship stray files (old log/, trades.jsonl, sol-usdc-log.md)
        if extra.name not in FILES and extra.name not in (DESK_NAME, desk_json.FILLS_NAME):
            if extra.is_dir():
                shutil.rmtree(extra, ignore_errors=True)
            else:
                extra.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    for cf in CODE_FILES:
        hashes[f"code:{cf.name}"] = hashlib.sha256(cf.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return hashes


def prune_wrangler_logs() -> None:
    cutoff = time.time() - 86400
    try:
        for p in WRANGLER_LOGS.glob("*"):
            if p.is_file() and p.stat().st_mtime < cutoff:
                p.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    except Exception:
        pass


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    force = "--force" in argv
    LOCK.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if _DH.MIRROR_FLAG.exists() and "--allow-mirror" not in argv:
        return 0  # box mirror: the PC publishes; never overwrite its newer data
    lock_fh = open(LOCK, "a+")
    if not _DH.try_lock(lock_fh):
        lock_fh.close()
        return 0  # another publish in flight
    try:
        hashes = stage()
        try:
            prev = json.loads(STATE.read_text()).get("hashes") or {}
        except Exception:
            prev = {}
        if not force and prev == hashes:
            return 0
        changed = sorted(k for k in hashes if prev.get(k) != hashes[k])

        tok = token()
        if not tok:
            log("PUBLISH_ERR missing CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN")
            return 1
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        try:
            deploy_rest(tok)
        except Exception as e:
            dt = round(time.monotonic() - t0, 1)
            log(f"PUBLISH_ERR sec={dt} {scrub(str(e), tok)[:800]}")
            return 1
        dt = round(time.monotonic() - t0, 1)
        tmp = STATE.with_suffix(".json.tmp")
        tmp.write_text(json.dumps({"published_pt": iso(), "hashes": hashes}, indent=2) + "\n")
        tmp.replace(STATE)
        log(f"PUBLISHED sec={dt} uploaded_files={LAST_UPLOAD[0]} uploaded_bytes={LAST_UPLOAD[1]} changed={','.join(changed)[:600]}")
        prune_wrangler_logs()
        return 0
    except Exception as e:  # never raise into the runner
        log(f"PUBLISH_ERR {type(e).__name__}")
        return 1
    finally:
        _DH.unlock(lock_fh)
        lock_fh.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

def _now_pt() -> str:
    return datetime.now(PT).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat()


def _log(msg: str) -> None:
    LOG.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    try:
        with open(LOG, "a", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
            f.write(f"{_now_pt()} {msg}\n")
    except OSError:
        pass


def _read_json(path: Path):
    try:
        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return None


def _read_jsonl_tail(path: Path, n: int) -> list:
    if not path.is_file():
        return []
    try:
        lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    except OSError:
        return []
    out = []
    for line in lines[-n:]:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        try:
            out.append(json.loads(line))
        except Exception:
            continue
    return out


def _runner_alive() -> dict:
    pidfile = ROOT / "runner.pid"
    stop = ROOT / "runner.stopped"
    pid = None
    alive = False
    if _DH.IS_WIN:
        # Windows: os.kill(pid, 0) would terminate the process. Use heartbeat freshness.
        try:
            import time as _t
            hb = ROOT / "runner-heartbeat.json"
            alive = hb.is_file() and (_t.time() - hb.stat().st_mtime) < 300
            pid = os.getpid() if alive else None
        except OSError:
            alive = False
    elif pidfile.is_file():
        raw = pidfile.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
        digits = "".join(c for c in raw if c.isdigit())
        if digits:
            try:
                pid = int(digits)
                os.kill(pid, 0)
                # Confirm argv looks like box_runner
                cmd = Path(f"/proc/{pid}/cmdline").read_bytes().split(b"\0")
                if any(b"box_runner.py" in c for c in cmd):
                    alive = True
            except (OSError, ValueError):
                alive = False
    return {
        "alive": alive,
        "pid": pid if alive else None,
        "deliberately_stopped": stop.is_file(),
    }


def build_snapshot(reason: str = "manual") -> dict:
    last = _read_json(ROOT / "last-check.json") or {}
    hb = _read_json(ROOT / "runner-heartbeat.json") or {}
    sched = _read_json(ROOT / "next-check-schedule.json") or {}
    cb = _read_json(ROOT / "cost-basis.json") or {}

            "unrealized_pnl_pct"
        )

    # Truncate public address only (never keys).

    addr_short = f"{addr[:4]}…{addr[-4:]}" if len(addr) > 10 else addr

def _ensure_bot_desk_files() -> None:
    """Keep bot-desk.html relative fetches working: sol-usdc-log.md + trades.jsonl
    in the same served directory as the desk (and index.html -> bot-desk.html).

    Prefer relative symlinks to ROOT so the desk always sees live files between
    snapshots. Fall back to atomic copy if linking fails. Never copies secrets.
    """
    DASH.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    # Default URL / should serve owner's desk
    index = DASH / "index.html"
    desk = DASH / "bot-desk.html"
    if desk.is_file():
        try:
            if index.is_symlink() or not index.exists():
                if index.is_symlink() and os.readlink(index) != "bot-desk.html":
                    index.unlink()
                    index.symlink_to("bot-desk.html")
                elif not index.exists():
                    index.symlink_to("bot-desk.html")
            elif index.is_file() and not index.samefile(desk):
                # Demote unknown real index once
                legacy = DASH / "index-legacy.html"
                if not legacy.exists():
                    os.replace(index, legacy)
                if not index.exists():
                    index.symlink_to("bot-desk.html")
        except OSError as e:
            _log(f"BOT_DESK_INDEX_ERR {type(e).__name__}")

    pairs = (
        ("sol-usdc-log.md", ROOT / "sol-usdc-log.md"),
        ("trades.jsonl", ROOT / "trades.jsonl"),
    )
    for name, src in pairs:
        dest = DASH / name
        if not src.is_file():
            _log(f"BOT_DESK_MISSING {name}")
            continue
        rel = os.path.relpath(src, DASH)
        try:
            if dest.is_symlink():
                if os.readlink(dest) == rel:
                    continue
                dest.unlink()
            elif dest.exists():
                # Replace stale copy with symlink when possible
                dest.unlink()
            dest.symlink_to(rel)
            continue
        except OSError:
            pass
        # Atomic copy fallback
        try:
            tmp = dest.with_suffix(dest.suffix + ".tmp")
            tmp.write_bytes(src.read_bytes())
            os.replace(tmp, dest)
        except OSError as e:
            _log(f"BOT_DESK_SYNC_ERR {name} {type(e).__name__}")


def write_snapshot(reason: str = "manual") -> dict:
    DASH.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    _ensure_bot_desk_files()
    snap = build_snapshot(reason=reason)
    tmp = OUT.with_suffix(".json.tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(snap, indent=2, default=str) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    os.replace(tmp, OUT)
    _log(f"SNAPSHOT_OK reason={reason} total_usd={snap['wallet'].get('total_usd')}")
    return snap


def refresh(reason: str = "manual") -> dict:
    """Public hook for fill/morning/runner callers. Never raises."""
    if not __import__("degen_home").research_logging():
        # template: dashboard/data.json and the dashboard/ copies are not read by anything (the
        # dashboard uses desk.json built by dashboard_publish), so nothing is written here.
        return {"ok": True, "skipped": "template", "reason": reason}
    try:
        return write_snapshot(reason=reason)
    except Exception as e:
        _log(f"SNAPSHOT_ERR reason={reason} {type(e).__name__}")
        return {"ok": False, "error": type(e).__name__, "reason": reason}


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = list(argv if argv is not None else sys.argv[1:])
    reason = args[0] if args else "cli"
    snap = write_snapshot(reason=reason)
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "ok": True,
                "path": str(OUT),
                "generated_pt": snap.get("generated_pt"),
                "total_usd": (snap.get("wallet") or {}).get("total_usd"),
                "result": (snap.get("last_check") or {}).get("result"),
                "reason": reason,
            },
            sort_keys=True,
        )
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Portable base dir, secrets, venv and lock helpers (box + Windows PC). 2026-10-10 pcmove.

DEGEN_HOME env var wins; default is this file's own folder. Paths use forward
slashes (fine on Windows). Secrets come from <HOME>/secrets.json (flat dict of
NAME -> value; SOLANA_RPC_URLS is a list), plus <HOME>/.env and <HOME>/config.json (template).
Never prints secret values.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HOME = Path(os.environ.get("DEGEN_HOME") or Path(__file__).resolve().parent)
HOME_STR = str(HOME).replace("\\", "/")
IS_WIN = os.name == "nt"
VENV_DIR = HOME / ".venv"
VENV_PY = VENV_DIR / ("Scripts/python.exe" if IS_WIN else "bin/python")
SECRETS_FILE = HOME / "secrets.json"
MIRROR_FLAG = HOME / "MIRROR_ONLY"
_BOX_SECRETS = ()  # template: secrets come from .env / secrets.json only
ENV_FILE = HOME / ".env"
CONFIG_FILE = HOME / "config.json"  # copy config.example.json -> config.json


def _load_dotenv() -> None:
    """Load KEY=VALUE lines from <HOME>/.env into os.environ (.env wins over inherited values)."""
    try:
        for ln in ENV_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            ln = ln.strip()
            if not ln or ln.startswith("#") or "=" not in ln:
                continue
            k, v = ln.split("=", 1)
            k, v = k.strip(), v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
            if k and v:  # template: the bot's own .env wins over inherited environment
                os.environ[k] = v
            elif k:  # blank in .env = deliberately unset; drop any inherited (e.g. platform-injected) value
                os.environ.pop(k, None)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        pass


_load_dotenv()


def config() -> dict:
    try:
        return json.loads(CONFIG_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return {}


def tz_name() -> str:
    """Owner's time zone (IANA name): DEGEN_TZ, else config.json "timezone", else this machine's zone, else UTC."""
    from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
    cands = [os.environ.get("DEGEN_TZ"), config().get("timezone"), os.environ.get("TZ")]
    try:
        cands.append(Path("/etc/timezone").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip())
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        lt = os.path.realpath("/etc/localtime")
        if "zoneinfo/" in lt:
            cands.append(lt.split("zoneinfo/", 1)[1])
    except Exception:
        pass
    for c in cands:
        c = str(c or "").strip()
        if not c or c.upper().startswith("YOUR"):
            continue
        try:
            ZoneInfo(c)
            return c
        except Exception:
            continue
    return "UTC"


TZ_NAME = tz_name()
